Apple-200693386.title: Application Compliance Engineer
Apple-200693386.description:
Apple's Wallet, Payments, and Commerce teams are redefining how people pay, access, and interact with financial services. Our work powers Apple Pay, Transit, Access, Car Key, and other Wallet experiences. This Shanghai-based role helps our China applications meet applicable security, privacy, and regulatory requirements through practical engineering controls and audit readiness.

Apple is seeking an exceptional Application Compliance Engineer to focus on the regulatory and compliance issues that shape and maintain our compliance in China. You will be responsible for strategy, interpretation, advocacy, and execution across China regulatory, compliance, and partner engineering work. You will work in close partnership with our colleagues in Legal and Government Affairs, who lead on legal interpretation and government relations, and with WPC China leadership, ensuring that regulatory and compliance strategy reflects Apple’s priorities and presence in the country.

You will bring the engineering and business perspective that turns those efforts into workable outcomes, and you will bridge communication with our global teams design and delivery of audit controls and processes within the Wallet and Payment Engineering Team.  This is a highly technical, hands-on role that requires experiences and expertise in regulatory and compliance within financial services and banking sectors, managing controls in complex environments.  The successful candidate will drive the implementation and testing of appropriate controls and audit requirements with internal and external business units.

Working with application engineering, infrastructure, security, privacy, and compliance teams, you will help design, implement, and test controls for China operations. Areas of focus include MLPS 2.0, applicable China data localization requirements, and cross-border data transfers. Legal and Government Affairs lead legal interpretation and government relations; you will contribute technical analysis and implementation support.

You will use modern audit, development, and operations tools to maintain reliable audit evidence, identify control gaps, and coordinate remediation. In partnership with China and global teams, you will help embed compliance requirements into application design, delivery, and ongoing operations.

Partner with engineering, infrastructure, security, privacy, and compliance teams to translate agreed requirements into technical controls and documented acceptance criteria.
Support MLPS 2.0 assessment and audit readiness through technical scoping, control mapping, evidence collection, and control effectiveness testing.
Identify control gaps, assess technical impact, and coordinate remediation with engineering owners; track milestones, retest fixes, and escalate unresolved risks to your manager.
Prepare complete, accurate, and traceable audit evidence, including configurations, logs, access reviews, test results, and change records; support internal and external audits.
Work with Engineering, Privacy and Legal to document data flows, support compliance assessments, and implement agreed controls for data localization and cross-border data transfers, including access, storage, and transfer safeguards.
Validate controls such as least-privilege access, encryption, logging and monitoring, retention and deletion, and secure change management; automate repeatable evidence collection and testing where practical.
Collaborate with China and global engineering and privacy teams to integrate compliance into design and releases, and communicate requirements, findings, and remediation progress clearly.
Deliver assigned compliance projects under your manager’s direction, maintain clear documentation, and promote practical security and compliance awareness across partner teams.
Apple-200693386.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Hands-on experience designing, testing, and documenting audit controls, with the ability to obtain technical evidence and verify sample completeness and accuracy.
Solid understanding of application and security architectures, including identity and access management, encryption, logging, data flows, and cloud or enterprise infrastructure.
Working knowledge of China technology and data compliance, including MLPS 2.0, applicable data localization requirements, and cross-border data transfer requirements; ability to work with Engineering, Legal and Privacy on their technical implementation.
Experience applying compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, SOX, or GDPR, and mapping requirements to application controls; payments, fintech, or banking experience is a plus.
Ability to inspect system configurations, query logs, test controls, and maintain reproducible audit evidence while handling sensitive information appropriately.
Practical scripting or programming skills, such as Python or Java, to support control validation, data analysis, or evidence automation.
Ability to manage assigned projects and remediation workstreams, track dependencies, and escalate issues with clear technical context.
Strong collaboration and communication skills across engineering, security, compliance, privacy, and audit teams in China and globally.
Ability to work independently on defined deliverables, exercise sound judgment, and seek guidance as scope or risk increases.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information security, or 5+ years of equivalent, hands-on technology operations in large enterprise environments
Knowledge and understanding of security and compliance systems and thorough understanding of security principles and technical architectures
Significant experience working with large (the “Big 4”) external auditing firms, and certifications such as CISA or CISSP are a plus.

Apple-200660740.title: Audio Product Design Engineer
Apple-200660740.description:
Why Apple? We live in a mobile and device driven world where knowledge of the physical world around us is needed. We rely on this knowledge to get around, to learn about our environment and to enable spectacular new features for custom applications.   Apple is meeting those needs as robustly and as creatively as possible and is passionate about people who want to help meet that commitment. The success we are striving will be the result of very skilled people working in an environment which cultivates creativity, partnership, and thinking of old problems in new ways. If that sounds like the kind of environment that you find intriguing, then let's talk.

We invent the next generation of the world's finest consumer electronics. As a member of our Audio Product Design team, you would conceive, design, test, solve problems, and bring into production products that re-define the music experience. We work closely with many different multi-functional teams including Industrial Design, Audio Engineering, Radio Frequency, Safety, Hardware Engineering, EMC, Operations and Marketing. Expertly integrating so many different pieces into brand-new products means every single day is different.

- Support build activities including finding root cause for failures and solutions for issues that impede build progress.   

Building prototypes to validate function, manufacturability, and reliability.   
Analyze data generated from builds and design of experiments.   
Participate in design reviews to generate and receive constructive feedback.   
Perform tolerance analyses to predict performance of mechanisms, sensors, and cosmetic.   
Create specifications, detailed design and 2D documentation of parts and assemblies.   
Work with operations teams to evaluate and develop supply chains capable of manufacturing new subsystems and products.   
Interacting with vendors to develop manufacturing processes and tooling concepts.
Apple-200660740.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS and above in Mechanical Engineering, or 3+ years of experience in mechanical design.
Computer aided design (CAD) skills: 3D CAD experience required(NX preferred), 2D drafting and GD&T.
Knowledge of finite element analysis (FEA) theory and general mechanical engineering analysis.
Ability to travel to vendors during weekdays.
Fluent Mandarin and English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience of working with many different international teams or OEM/ODM vendors.
Hands-on experience of solving problem with engineering knowledge (material mechanics, statics, fluid dynamics…etc) and tools.
Deep understanding of engineering fundamentals and ability to apply concepts to new problems not listed in engineering textbooks.
Strong analytical skills and ability to apply statistical tools and techniques into real-world problem solving.
Post-processing knowledge for plastic and metal part, including assembly and fixture design.
Industry experiences from medical, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace and other fields with relevant technology and development models.
Experience in Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA), statistical tolerance analysis techniques, functional dimensioning, and geometric tolerancing.
Experience with component modules (Audio drivers, batteries, power supplies, camera modules, etc.)
Design of audio subsystems (microphone, speaker, receiver)
Experience of using AI tools in previous programs for solving engineering problems

Apple-200685830.title: BTP Platform Security Engineer
Apple-200685830.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. By bringing passion, dedication, and technical excellence to your job, there is no telling what you could accomplish. We are establishing a centralized team to support enterprise landscape modernization, leveraging the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), AliCloud, and other cloud technologies to drive secure, seamless application onboarding and cloud-native integrations.
As a Cloud Platform Security Engineer, you will define baseline security controls, governance frameworks, and secure reference architectures that enable development teams to adopt cloud technologies safely. You will work closely with functional, technical, and security stakeholders to translate complex compliance requirements into automated engineering controls, ensuring a secure, compliant, and resilient cloud platform ecosystem.

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security controls across SAP BTP and hybrid cloud runtimes. You will author secure reference architectures, trust-boundary diagrams, and network security topologies to safeguard enterprise integrations and microservices. Additionally, you will partner with cross-functional teams to automate security testing, support compliance audits, and drive platform security optimization.

Design and implement baseline security controls, encryption strategies (at rest and in transit), and secrets management standards across Cloud Foundry, Kyma, and multi-cloud runtimes.
Develop and maintain secure reference architectures, trust-boundary diagrams, network security zones, and traffic flow models for enterprise integrations and microservices.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define API security policies, rate-limiting rules, and data architecture security standards.
Embed robust security controls and automated compliance mechanisms into platform designs to minimize risk.
Build proofs-of-concept (PoCs) and rapid prototypes to demonstrate the feasibility of emerging security and cloud technologies.
Support internal and external compliance audits, risk assessments, and vulnerability remediations.
Drive ongoing platform optimization, elevating system reliability and cloud security standards across the ecosystem.
Apple-200685830.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience (5+ years) in software engineering or cybersecurity, with a focus on designing, securing, and operating enterprise cloud platform solutions.
Experience implementing secure configurations on the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) ecosystem, including application development/extension on Cloud Foundry or Kyma runtimes.
Experience securing integration touchpoints, including API gateway security, policy enforcement, rate-limiting, and payload validation in SAP Integration Suite or enterprise API Management platforms.
Experience securing message brokers and event mesh systems (such as Advanced Event Mesh, Apache Kafka, or Solace PubSub+).
Experience translating compliance and security requirements into actionable engineering controls.
Experience collaborating with multi-functional product and engineering teams to drive security initiatives.
Other: SAP BTP Certification (such as Administrator, Security, Technology Consultant, or related).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience defining and enforcing enterprise SAP security governance frameworks, secure API policies, and data classification standards.
Experience with DevSecOps practices, including integrating automated security testing (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into CI/CD pipelines and SAP Cloud Transport Management (CTMS).
Experience implementing cloud observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace, SAP Cloud ALM, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk) for audit logging and security event detection.
Experience applying zero-trust architecture principles and secure network topology designs across hybrid (on-premises to public cloud) infrastructures.

Apple-200674312.title: Backend Engineer - G&A Solutions Engineering
Apple-200674312.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.  Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.

You will be part of the core team that builds services and integrations to/from a SaaS/cloud-based ERP systems both external and internal to Apple. This is a hands-on role in the development of software systems to support existing and new product features. This is a highly collaborative role that will require working with many different teams and internal customers in a fast paced environment. It is a great opportunity for an experienced and results-oriented person who enjoys working with cross-functional teams.

At Apple, code quality and functional quality is aways at the forefront and one of the key measures of success.

You will be part of an Agile team and take part in every aspect of the product, from planning to design to implementation and documentation. You will work closely with engineers, QA, and project managers throughout the software lifecycle in successfully delivering best-in-class secure and scalable systems.
You will play a key role developing distributed build and orchestration systems, increase the velocity and confidence of our deployments with enhanced observability and continuous delivery, and design tools and workflows that improve engineering efficiency.

Apple-200673790.title: Battery Test Engineer
Apple-200673790.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.    
This position is in the Battery Technology Development Team. It will be responsible for electrical testing, mechanical testing, and electro-chemical characterization of Lithium batteries within the test labs. The position will also work closely with other teams (i.e. R&D, Applications, and Qualification) to develop and implement any electrical tests and test procedures to characterize battery performance. The position will be responsible for all facets of the battery testing including development and scheduling of electrical tests, data collection and procedure documentation, interpretation and communication of test results, and maintenance and calibration of all test equipment and meters.

Develop and implement test protocols to measure and characterize cell properties and electro-chemical performance  
Develop and implement process flows for the effective implementation of the protocols   
Develop, implement, and document validation methods to ensure the integrity of the lab data   
Coordinate characterization data collection   
Coordinate the acquisition or in-house design and manufacture of small tools for lab use   
Resolve need for and schedule/perform routine maintenance of test equipment and meters   
Collect and analyze test data, write-up reports as necessary   
Maintain standard operating procedure database   
Collaborate with team on necessary deviations in test, detail any procedure changes   
Communicate results to engineering team   
Refine/Update test procedures and documents   
Train and mentor technicians in the operation and upkeep of test equipment and tools

Bachelor’s degree plus 2 - 5 years experience with testing various battery technologies
Ability to interpret battery test results and communicate to team
Understanding of test requirements and ability to convert into test protocols
Clear communication (written & verbal) in both English and Mandarin.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Ability to operate and all testing equipment and tools
Capable of making test choices based on electrochemistry nuances
Able to function and interact in a multilevel team environment
Data management and statistical analysis experience useful
Database experience desired

Apple-200675970.title: Business Analytics Developer, People Analytics
Apple-200675970.description:
At Apple, our greatest resource is our people, and the People Analytics Team is dedicated to ensuring Apple's employees are able to do the best work of their lives. 
The People Analytics team is looking for a versatile, self-driven developer who has hands-on depth across data analysis, business analysis, and analytics product development, to craft, implement, and operate solutions that have direct and measurable impact to the teams that support our people. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a dynamic team delivering analytics capabilities across the people domain, in the areas of recruitment, employee relations, people survey, talent planning, and a number of other strategic focus areas for the organisation.
As a professional who combines deep analytics capability with strong business analysis instincts, working with a diverse team of experts, imagine what you could do at Apple.

The Business Analytics Developer will play a pivotal role in the team, working with data from the Apple enterprise data warehouse across multiple systems in the Apple HRIS landscape to derive powerful insights for leadership, and build analytics products that drive a positive employee experience across Apple. You translate complex, often ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, combining strong data analysis with clear, compelling visualisations, and communicating findings in a way that directly shapes decisions. You operate with a high degree of autonomy, bringing curiosity, structure, and stakeholder confidence to every engagement.

Design, develop, and deploy reports, analytics, and dashboards using data visualisation tools like Tableau, enabling leaders and business partners to make confident, data-driven decisions. 
Collaborate with business stakeholders, regional coordinators, and leaders to identify and clarify reporting requirements, translating high-level, often vague requests into tangible prototypes and iterating to find the right solution.
Build and optimise data models, schemas, and views in Snowflake and relational databases to underpin reliable, high-quality analytics products.
Re-engineer existing analytics and reporting ecosystems to improve simplicity, standardisation, and security, while delivering new feature implementations.
Develop metrics and measurement frameworks to evaluate the performance of analytics products and people programmes, and regularly communicate results to business partners and leadership.
Present analytics findings and data stories clearly to senior stakeholders and executives, adapting depth and format to the audience.
Research new technologies, methods, and best practices across data analytics and data visualisation to continuously improve the analytical capabilities of the team.
Maintain existing analytics products and reporting assets, ensuring accuracy, currency, and alignment with evolving business needs.
Collaborate with global people analytics and IS&T teams to implement analytics solutions, communicating effectively across time zones and cultures.
Adhere to all policies, standards, and practices defined by Apple's Data Compliance and Security team.
Apple-200675970.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
7+ years of experience developing and maintaining analytics products and reports, using Tableau or other analytics visualisation tools, that identify meaningful data insights and drive decisions.
Strong data analysis and business analysis skills — able to frame a business question, identify the right data, apply appropriate analytical methods, and communicate findings with clarity.

Apple-200677789.title: Business Manager, High Potential Developer Engagement - Greater China
Apple-200677789.description:
The App Store team is looking for a Business Manager to help grow the High Potential program in Greater China, with a focus on developer engagement. High potential developers are broadly defined as those with notable business growth opportunities and/or broader impact on the App Store ecosystem. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in the ongoing success
of an important segment of the Apple developer ecosystem in one of our most dynamic markets.

As a Business Manager, you will work directly with developers to understand their businesses, identify growth areas tied to App Store features and best practices, and drive relevant business KPIs. This includes using takeaways from developer engagements to contribute to ongoing optimization and strategic priorities for the High Potential program.

In addition to helping High Potential developers reach positive business outcomes, you will also find ways to foster positive sentiment and identify developer advocates within the segment. With this new engagement approach, Apple aims to reach more developers than ever before and ensure those developers derive meaningful, measurable benefits through a more structured, consistent working relationship with the App Store team.

Developer Engagement: Engage with hundreds of High Potential developers in the Greater China market using scalable communication channels and tools, including periodic 1:1 conversations, to drive business growth, share best practices, advocate for App Store features, and strengthen relationships.

Performance Tracking: Use AirTable and other tools to manage your pipeline of engagement with developers, from initial outreach to progress on actions (e.g., feature adoption), and the identification of success stories.

Process Optimization: Provide ongoing feedback to improve processes, tools, and the developer engagement playbook with a focus on measurable outcomes and regional applicability.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with local App Store and cross-functional teams on developer community engagement initiatives and events tailored to the Greater China market.

Educational Programs: Support the planning and delivery of developer educational programs, including online and in-person formats, such as App Store workshops.
Apple-200677789.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Native or professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese, alongside business proficiency in English for internal global collaboration.
8+ years of professional experience with a deep understanding of App Store business models and related platform features, especially games and auto-renewable subscriptions.
Knowledge of App Store business critical metrics and their relevance to various apps and the customer lifecycle, including top of funnel, payer conversion, retention, and re-engagement / win-back.
Deep understanding of the Greater China app ecosystem, including local market trends and developer dynamics.
Ability to analyze and communicate data-driven results clearly and effectively.
Proficiency in using project management/CRM software and tracking performance towards specific, measurable goals.
Enthusiasm for small/mid-sized developers, their needs, and their unique business challenges.
Ability to efficiently manage time, developer engagements, and developer expectations to ensure program success given KPI targets.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a global team environment.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
BA/BS degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or equivalent experience.
A track record of working with developers to improve business performance and platform feature adoption.
Experience with presenting to and engaging audiences of senior execs.
Experience managing direct reports / a small team while simultaneously taking on substantial hands-on individual contributor work.

Apple-200678942.title: CN-技术专家
Apple-200678942.description:
Apple Store 零售店集中展现了 Apple 最精彩的方方面面。我们运用我们的专业知识帮助人们做自己喜欢的事，提供 Apple 独家体验。在 Apple，我们认为营造包容的环境是我们共同的责任，我们将携手合作，打造让所有人都有归属感的文化，激励大家在工作中一展所长。

作为技术专家，你为所有顾客提供技术支持，以娴熟技巧进行故障诊断，并激发顾客对 Apple 产品和服务的热情。你提供出色的服务，确保顾客能够充分利用 Apple 产品和服务。 

技术专家还确保顾客了解各种维修方案以及 Apple 产品和服务。

了解 Apple 产品、服务以及 Genius Bar 天才吧维修流程并及时掌握最新资讯，以协助进行高效优质的维修。

使用 Apple 提供的所有工具和资源，带着同理心和关怀，为遇到 Apple 产品或软件问题的顾客提供支持。

分析、诊断和解决特定 Apple 硬件和软件出现的维修问题。

与团队 Leader 合作，找出反复出现的维修问题和其他维修疑虑，确保 Apple 会获得相关反馈。

为 Apple 顾客提供出色的服务，尽力了解其需求，发掘发展用户的机会，提出产品和服务建议，并为他们介绍相关的购买方式。

根据需要执行其他任务，包括但不限于在销售楼面内外为面向顾客的活动提供支持。

尊重彼此之间的差异，愿意去了解他人，共同营造包容的环境。

在日常活动中展现 Apple 的包容性与多元化价值观。

你应能根据业务需要适应工作安排，这可能包括在晚间、周末和公共节假日在零售店工作，并依照当地法律，在遵循已获批调整措施的情况下，根据排定的班次按时上班。
你还应能流利使用当地语言进行书面和口头交流。

你可以：
展现出拥有 Apple 产品和服务的相关技术专业知识。
在顾客服务环境中，按照故障诊断步骤确定技术问题的根本原因。
运用出色的人际交往能力，带着关怀应对顾客服务问题。
不断了解 Apple 产品和服务以及第三方产品并加深巩固相关知识，以提升顾客体验。
适应快节奏的工作环境，同时兼顾多项任务。
善于在团队环境中工作，愿与其他团队成员共担责任和困难。
在处理敏感或保密信息方面值得信任，秉持 Apple 的核心价值观。
保持好奇心和开放心态，向他人学习，帮助彼此成长。

Apple-200674969.title: Cellular Protocol Stack Development Engineer, Wireless Tech and Ecosystems
Apple-200674969.description:
At Apple, we don’t just build products — we create experiences that redefine entire industries. It’s the diversity of our people and their ideas that fuels innovation across everything we do, from breakthrough technologies to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join the Wireless Technologies and Eco-Systems (WTE) organization and and drive innovation that matters! 
As part of the Wireless team you we will be working on building solutions for Wireless technologies. We are looking for a highly reciprocal individual who can excel in a high-paced environment. Be ready to make something extraordinary when you come here. Dynamic, encouraging people and innovative, industry-defining technologies are the norm at Apple. The people who work here have reinvented and defined entire industries with our products and services. The same real passion for innovation also applies to our business practices - strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it. You should join the Apple Wireless SW Developing Team if you want to help deliver the next amazing Apple product.

Design and develop cellular protocol stack software.
Bring up iOS productions with cellular features.
Diagnose, debug, and resolve cellular issues with rigorous root-cause methodology.
Analyze and optimize cellular performance through systematic analysis and data-driven refinement.
Support comprehensive production testing across all functional, performance and regulatory requirements.
Apple-200674969.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
2+ years of hands-on experience in a cellular protocol stack (NAS/RRC/PDCP/RLC/MAC) developing role.
Good knowledge of wireless communication and computer networks.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
Quick learning capability in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in both English and Chinese.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experienced in cellular system design as plus.
Experienced in LTE/NR firmware development as plus.
Deep knowledge of LTE or NR cross layers as well as end to end system as plus.
Experienced data analytic and data-informed solution design as plus.
Hands on experience in GenAI and machine learning as plus.

Apple-200686555.title: Cloud Engineer, Health Software
Apple-200686555.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The Apple Health team is looking for a hardworking Sr. Cloud Engineer with a background in large scale engineering support. You will enjoy using technology to automate solutions and optimize outcomes focusing on data/backend engineering, continuous integration and continuous deployment in a fast-changing world of software delivery.

Apple's Health team is seeking a high-energy Site Reliability/Cloud Engineer. As a member of our dynamic group, you'll have the rare and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple's customers every day.

Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP to support Apple Health software services
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable, and repeatable software delivery
Write automation tools and scripts in Python and Bash to reduce manual toil and improve operational efficiency
Monitor system health and performance using observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and drive resolution of incidents
Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes in large-scale production environments
Administer and support distributed data systems including NoSQL databases, Zookeeper andSpark
Collaborate cross-functionally with software engineers, security teams, and product teams to define and implement infrastructure best practices
Own and improve build and release systems, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance at scale
Conduct root cause analysis on production incidents and implement preventative measures to reduce recurrence
Participate in capacity planning, performance tuning, and cost optimization across cloud environments
Maintain source control workflows and repository hygiene using Git or SVN
Document systems, runbooks, and operational procedures to support team knowledge sharing and continuity

Hands-on experience in engineering, Cloud, or as a software engineering staff member
Strong programming and scripting fundamentals, Python and Bash
Modern web services architectures, cloud platforms such as AWS, Tencent
Source control management such as Git
Linux fundamentals, experience with hardening operating system images
Hands-on experience with Log mining frameworks like, Elastic, Prometheus, Cloudwatch etc
Container services(Docker/Kubernetes), UNIX system administration
Grafana or similar for investigating or monitoring problems on systems
Release and management of NoSQL, Zookeeper, Spark
Proficient in English and Mandarin language, both written and verbal communication
In-depth knowledge of build/release systems and process
BS Computer Science or equivalent experience

Passionate about Continuous Build, Integration, Test, and Delivery systems
Able to quickly learn new and existing technologies
Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical capabilities
A desire to write tools and applications to automate work rather than do everything by hand
Self-motivated, pro-active and solution-oriented individual

Apple-200685358.title: Cloud Performance Engineer
Apple-200685358.description:
Join the team that serves as Apple’s nerve center: Information Systems and Technology (IS&T). From Apple Pay and the Apple Online Store to our global data center operations, IS&T designs, builds, and runs the critical enterprise systems that millions of customers and employees rely on every day.
The SAP Quality Engineering team safeguards the performance, resilience, and scalability of Apple’s mission-critical SAP systems and cloud-hosted enterprise applications. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end performance across cloud environments—with a primary focus on Alibaba Cloud alongside AWS. You will work across application runtimes, cloud infrastructure, databases, and networks, ensuring our platforms maintain exceptional responsiveness and reliability under real-world enterprise scale.

As a Cloud Performance Engineer, you will own the end-to-end performance and capacity engineering for enterprise applications hosted on cloud infrastructure. You will design high-fidelity performance test scenarios, decompose latency across complex global network and application paths, and identify bottlenecks before they impact users. In addition, you will partner closely with architecture, database, and software engineering teams to establish performance baselines, build actionable observability, and guide technical sign-offs for production workloads.

Architect and execute comprehensive performance, load, stress, and soak test scenarios that accurately model real-world business concurrency, data volumes, and mixed-load endurance behavior.
Engineer and optimize cloud infrastructure primarily on Alibaba Cloud—with complementary depth on AWS—tuning Kubernetes clusters, autoscaling behaviors, compute/storage sizing, load balancers, and network latency.
Decompose and resolve latency across the complete request lifecycle, evaluating DNS, TLS, proxies, API gateways, application runtimes, and backend databases such as SAP HANA.
Build deep observability and automated monitoring solutions using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing platforms, incorporating AI-assisted tooling for anomaly detection and rapid root-cause analysis.
Optimize event-driven architectures and publish-subscribe pipelines on Kafka and enterprise event brokers, tuning topic partitioning, consumer lag, throughput, and backpressure handling.
Lead production incident investigations and post-go-live triage under tight deadlines, conducting thorough root cause analysis and collaborating with engineering teams to deploy lasting fixes.
Drive capacity and cost-to-performance modeling during architectural reviews, establishing performance benchmarks, entry/exit criteria, and automated test integration within continuous delivery pipelines.
Apple-200685358.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in software or performance engineering, with demonstrated ownership of production performance for enterprise cloud applications.
Hands-on experience engineering and tuning cloud-hosted applications on Alibaba Cloud, along with production experience on AWS.
Experience configuring, sizing, and performance-tuning relational databases, including SAP HANA, on cloud infrastructure.
Experience modeling realistic workloads and conducting load, stress, soak, and capacity testing using tools such as Apache JMeter, k6, Gatling, or LoadRunner Enterprise.
Experience decomposing latency across complex multi-tier architectures and utilizing telemetry to identify root causes and quantify improvements.
Experience managing production performance incidents, including real-time triage and authoring detailed technical root cause analyses.
Professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience operating enterprise workloads in China regions on Alibaba Cloud, including local networking architectures, load balancing, and observability tooling.
Experience evaluating and optimizing SAP BTP runtime sizing, service quotas, and integration behaviors on hyperscaler platforms.
Experience implementing application performance monitoring (APM) and distributed tracing systems (e.g., Dynatrace, Grafana, Datadog, or AppDynamics).
Professional certifications on major cloud platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud ACP/ACE, AWS Solutions Architect/Specialty, or SAP on Cloud).
Experience with enterprise integration patterns and architectures, such as S/4HANA, OData services, Fiori, and Core Data Services (CDS).
Experience applying AI and machine learning tools to automate performance test analysis, log synthesis, or anomaly detection workflows.
Experience collaborating across cross-functional engineering teams within an Agile or Scrum delivery framework.

Apple-200685351.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
Apple-200685351.description:
Bring passion and dedication to your work and there's no telling what you could accomplish! 
As part of the SAP Cloud Team at Apple, you'll play a key role in supporting enterprise functions and solving complex business challenges. Leveraging the cloud and cutting-edge technologies, we deliver elegant, innovative, and easy-to-use solutions to drive business success.
We’re looking for an experienced, passionate, and dependable Cloud Engineer to work on projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to build enterprise-grade, cloud-native services on hyperscalers such as Alibaba Cloud or Amazon WebServices.
Come make a difference at Apple and let your skills, passion, and dedication drive our digital evolution forward.

Collaborate and contribute to designing scalable, reliable, and secure enterprise solutions.
Contribute to the design and implement robust cloud native solutions
Understanding of containerization and orchestration concepts for designing and building scalable and resilient modern event and micro-services based systems
Stay at the forefront of exploring and learning new technologies/frameworks to continuously enhance expertise.
Demonstrate the ability to learn quickly and apply knowledge to solve complex problems.
Exhibit strong problem-solving skills and proactively drive issue resolution across teams.
Be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and mindful of established schedules and scopes, ensuring effective project delivery.
Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders, fostering positive and open interpersonal relationships.
Adapt to working with multi-regional teams across different time zones.

Experience as a Cloud/DevOps Engineer or in a similar role with 5+ years of exposure.
Knowledge of working with public cloud providers such as AliCloud or AWS or equivalent
Understanding of networking concepts on Cloud, like VPCs/Subnets, Firewalls and LoadBalancers.
Knowledge of CI/CD and configuration management systems.
Knowledge of working with OS environments and good programming skills in Python and scripting
Understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to continuously assess and improve system reliability, and performance
Have passion to drive automation to streamline manual processes and enhance productivity across the organization.
MS/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Hands on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent
Analytical & problem solving skills, ability to communicate ideas clearly
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a strong focus on teamwork.
Experience with emerging technologies such as Generative AI in a cloud platform context.
Certifications like Alibaba Cloud Associate or Alibaba Cloud Professional is a plus.

Apple-200678631.title: Cloud Traffic Engineer
Apple-200678631.description:
We are responsible for the modernization, reliability and observability of Wallets, Payments and Commerce traffic infrastructure. Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. As the demand for our services continues to grow rapidly we are forming a team to best position ourselves to deliver a service to the highest level, as expected at Apple. We handle both customer facing (external) and internal traffic which have strict privacy and security requirements.

This is a team of software/systems/network engineers directly responsible for traffic globally for Wallets, Payments and Commerce. This includes services such as Apple Pay, Apple Card, Apple Cash, Identity, Transit and more. 

Ensure the highest level of up-time and quality of service to Apple’s customers through operational quality. 
Design, maintain, and improve global production traffic infrastructure. 
Ownership of reliability issues using a wide variety of tools.
Identify areas to improve service resiliency through techniques such as chaos engineering, performance / load testing, and game days.

Apple-200472645.title: Computer Vision Algorithm Engineer
Apple-200472645.description:
The display technology team features a collaborative environment with creative, smart talents, world-class products and cutting-edge technologies. Team provides opportunities for individuals to contribute across a wide spectrum of disciplines. Best in class engineering excellence and thoroughness are expected and encouraged. Innovation, IP and patent creation are highly supported and valued. Pushing the envelope to design and ship innovative products with best-in-class technologies and user experiences are the main goals of the display technology team

This individual will play a key role in computer vision/image processing algorithms design and development to enable display and other optical components calibration and metrology. You will work closely with cross-functional groups to ensure the success of current and future Apple display/optical products. Candidate will be responsible for,

-  Specify, design and implement metrology and calibration algorithms during Apple new product introduction (NPI) process and mass production

-  Develop, optimize, qualify and debug the algorithms and software

-  Integrate and validate the algorithms in manufacturing test equipment

-  Evaluate efficacy of the algorithms as compared to human visual inspection

-  Define algorithm performance verification specs and review existing algorithms 

-  Collaborate with other team members to deploy the algorithms/SW to factories during the NPI process

-  Analyze large amounts of NPI performance data

Apple-200678066.title: Contact Center Infrastructure Engineer
Apple-200678066.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

The Infrastructure Operations team is a global team of highly technical individuals who keep the Apple Store Online’s telecommunications platforms running smoothly. We shift between forward-looking projects where we envision future solutions to troubleshooting and improving the contact routing we have in place today. In this role, you will focus on administration of Apple’s contact distribution platform within China (chat, task, and email).

You will need to be highly analytical, detail oriented, technically savvy and should possess a deep understanding of multimedia contact center systems with excellent troubleshooting skills to be successful in this role. You will rely on your strong communication and presentation skills when interacting with others at all levels within Apple. Your experience in a contact center environment will enable you to work independently, while supporting a regional business unit to align with global goals.

Apple-200674248.title: DFM Engineer-Flex Assembly / FPCA
Apple-200674248.description:
As we all know, Apple produces phenomenal products, we focus on innovation and quality, your great ideas are so meaningful to Apple. We are open and encourage you to implement your great concepts, ideas and methodology to help both Apple and yourself. We are owning the industry and doing revolution of technology. 

The DFM team is an important process and quality team from initial design to the success of mass production and maintain product truly practical and perfect. We are looking for a DFM engineer who will focus on flexible printed circuits assembly manufacturing process setup, quality control and continuous improvements. Looking forward to having you join us, you will be Apple’s greatest value.

-  Acts as project leader leads all aspects of a variety of projects, work with factories and manage on technical and quality.

-  Collaboration with upstream and downstream on design, process, quality, specifications and issues.

-  Plans, develops and implements technical procedures for Flexible Printed Circuit Assembly (FPCA) manufacturing process&quality requirements.

-  Provides early manufacturing involvement to ensure new products is manufacturable. Perform design, manufacturing process, quality review, identify design and manufacturing risks, provide design and process solutions during New Product Introduction (NPI) to mass production(MP), and handle the implementations and qualification.

-  Establish guidelines, Standard Operating Procedure & Best Known Method for manufacturing process & quality control.

-  Support projects in different regions, manage NPI projects and builds, improve quality and efficiency, to ensure seamless transition to MP.
Apple-200674248.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor degree In Engineering or Science disciplines

3 years process or quality engineering experience in electronic industry.

Good English communication, CET-4 or equivalent level, problem solving skills and know about and presentation skills.

Good team-player and independent, able to work under fast pace, committed and result orientated.

Able to apply process/quality tool similar as: PDCA, CPK, SPC, FMEA and etc.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Master degree or MBA a plus

5~10 years of engineering/ design/manufacturing/NPI/engineering program management and quality or supplier management in relevant fields, SMT and assembly experience and managerial experience will be preferred.

Familiar with quality control tools, 6 sigma green belt or above. Know about reliability test, failure analysis methodology and tools like SEM/EDX/XPS, etc. Familiar with data analysis tools like JMP, MiniTab, etc.

Resolve hot issues, able to relocate and onsite support critical NPI/sustaining projects as vitally.

Work with multiple functional groups, demonstrated strong leadership and problem solving skills.

Passionate , highly independent, good discipline, responsible and trust worthy. 

Experience of coding like Python, Tableau…, smart manufacturing, digital transformation or Artificial intelligence/Machine learning is an advantage.

Apple-200676915.title: DRAM Design Validation Engineer
Apple-200676915.description:
Do you love crafting elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Join Apple's Silicon Technologies group and help design and deliver our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient processors and Systems-on-Chip (SoC). In this role, you will be at the center of ensuring seamless DRAM memory integration across Apple's SoC platforms — directly contributing to the silicon that powers every Apple device.

As our DRAM Design Validation Engineer, you will be ensuring the successful integration of DRAM memories with SoC devices, partnering with cross-functional teams and external vendors to deliver world-class memory solutions.

• Collaborate with design, verification, and integration engineers to ensure memory controller and PHY requirements are clearly defined, covering the full scope of DRAM-based corner cases.
• Partner with Architecture, MCU, DDRPHY, and DRAM vendor teams to develop and validate Apple's main memory features.
• Ensure DRAM simulations meet Apple's performance, power, and reliability requirements.
• Define and fulfill internal and external DRAM silicon and package-level testing needs.
• Debug RMA material with DRAM-related defects, driving root cause analysis and resolution.
• Work closely with DRAM vendors to improve memory performance and power efficiency on Apple systems.
• Drive roadmaps and technical specifications with memory vendors for next-generation technology node devices.
Apple-200676915.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in DRAM development.
Experience in DRAM simulation and memory interface verification, with a solid understanding of DDR-PHY and Memory Controller design.
Familiarity with memory test patterns and DRAM reliability principles.
Experience in failure analysis of DRAM devices.
Professional proficiency in English required.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong knowledge of DRAM cell architectures, memory organization, and periphery design for low-power DRAM.
Hands-on experience with LPDDRx I/O characterization and qualification.
Knowledge of advanced packaging technologies (PoP, TSV, etc.) and their impact on DRAM signal and power integrity.
Excellent hardware and software debugging skills.
Proven track record working collaboratively with DRAM vendors.
Strong background in computer architecture.
Programming proficiency in Python.
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly across teams.

Apple-200677835.description:

Apple-200679797.title: Data Services Engineer
Apple-200679797.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Are you interested in building high-performance, highly scalable and available database systems that support Apple’s current and future growth?  Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? If so, please read ahead!

Wallets, Payments and Commerce (WPC) Engineering is looking for a skilled Data Services Engineer to help architect, scale, and evolve our data infrastructure across cloud and on-premise environments. 

Our team is responsible for delivering high-performance, highly available data services — including relational, NoSQL, streaming, and search platforms — that power Apple's financial systems at massive scale. 

This position requires a highly motivated individual who likes large-scale challenges in a fast-paced environment. This role requires the ability to work independently on live production systems while collaborating with multiple teams. If you are passionate about building infrastructure that operates at the intersection of scale, resilience, and innovation, we want to hear from you.

Drive the design and operational excellence of critical data services, work closely with application teams, and lead automation initiatives that reduce toil and increase reliability. 

Operate in a multi-cloud environment spanning AWS and Ali Cloud, alongside Apple's internal/in-house platforms — evaluating internally available database offerings against Ali Cloud services to guide platform and vendor decisions, and building custom observability and metrics solutions by combining Apple internal tooling with open-source frameworks.
Apple-200679797.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
5+ years of hands-on experience operating and scaling distributed data platforms — including Cassandra, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis — in large-scale production environments
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects independently — from scoping and design through delivery and post-launch ownership
Deep expertise with multi-cloud architectures
With data services like Aurora Postger,RDS MSK, ElastiCache) and experience designing hybrid cloud environments.
Familiarity with Ali Cloud services (e.g., ApsaraDB, Kafka on Ali Cloud, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch equivalents) and the ability to evaluate and compare internally available databases and in-house platforms against Ali Cloud offerings to inform build-vs-adopt decisions
Ability to design and implement custom observability and metrics solutions for DataServices — combining in-house tooling with open-source frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) — to support monitoring across AWS, Ali Cloud, and internal platforms.
Strong infrastructure-as-code proficiency using Terraform, Ansible, Crossplane, or equivalent — with a track record of building reusable, scalable automation
Experience deploying and operating containerized database workloads on Kubernetes in production
Solid Python skills for automation, operational tooling, and platform workflows
Deep understanding of database internals — query optimization, cluster tuning, capacity planning, and failure analysis
Proven experience designing and executing HA/DR strategies, zero-downtime migrations, and large-scale infrastructure transitions
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across engineering teams

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience building or improving observability and alerting frameworks for database fleet monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry)
Experience provisioning and managing AWS Managed Data Services (RDS Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache) using Crossplane — defining cloud infrastructure as Kubernetes-native custom resources
Familiarity with security and compliance requirements in financial data systems
Background in platform migrations — data center-to-cloud, infrastructure consolidation, or cloud-to-cloud transitions
Experience at elevating team technical standards through code review, runbooks, and shared tooling
Exposure to emerging technologies including vector databases or AI-ready data infrastructure

Apple-200683730.title: Data Services SRE Manager - ASE Databases
Apple-200683730.description:
Apple's Services Engineering organization (ASE) is seeking an experienced data systems engineering manager to join our Databases SRE organization. The organization is expanding its footprint into Shanghai and is seeking an experienced engineering manager to build out and lead this site.

The Databases SRE organization is responsible for the full portfolio of database and data service technologies that Apple's internet services are built on, Apache Cassandra, Apache Kafka, Apache Solr, Redis/Valkey, etcd and other coordination services, and the platforms that run them. This is a cross-service role from day one: you will build and lead a team accountable for the reliability, scalability, and performance of all of these technologies as operated from the Shanghai site, and act as the site lead for the Databases SRE organization there.

ASE Databases SRE teams develop applications and tooling that are safe, reliable, scalable, and fast. This work requires an innovative spirit and an extraordinary degree of care and rigor in engineering. Team members contribute to all major components of our data service deployment infrastructure, including maintenance automation, backup services, monitoring and alerting tooling and dashboards, deployment architecture, and upstream contributions to the open source projects we run, focused on stability, performance, and scaling.

The team's work is deployed at massive scale, serving millions of queries per second over hundreds of petabytes of data across our data centers worldwide. It also has big impact, forming the platform upon which iCloud and many other internet services at Apple are built. In ASE, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users and is critical to the success of some of the most visible current and future Apple features.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We are seeking a manager with real domain experience who is comfortable working in the details, setting technical direction across several data service technologies rather than a single one, while building a new site from the ground up.

Hire, lead, develop, and grow a team of Site Reliability Engineers supporting Apple's data service platforms: Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Redis/Valkey, and coordination services such as etcd and zookeeper
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of these mission-critical data platforms as operated from the Shanghai site
Act as site lead for the Databases SRE organization in Shanghai, growing the site's scope and capability over time
Set technical direction for automation and scaling initiatives that apply across the portfolio rather than to a single technology
Drive incident response, post-incident reviews, and the systemic improvements that reduce operational toil
Establish and refine SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and change management
Manage and participate in on-call rotations and ensure sustainable, well-supported operational coverage
Partner with software engineering, Core Storage, and Analytics teams to influence system design for reliability, scalability, and operability
Engage internal platform customers with a high degree of customer focus, building credibility with engineers and partners across Apple
Communicate clearly across a geographically distributed organization to build a culture of visibility, transparency, and shared ownership
Apple-200683730.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Engineering management experience leading infrastructure, SRE, or data platform teams
Experience developing or leading work in distributed systems, database systems, storage engines, validation engineering, or performance engineering
Breadth across more than one data service technology, and the appetite to go deep on several (no single technology defines this role)
Experience developing critical internet services and/or platform infrastructure
Understanding of core SRE concepts: monitoring, alerting, and incident management
Advanced understanding of data structures and algorithms in storage and indexing
Familiarity with modern Java, and optionally Python or Go
Expertise in project management, project planning, and making the unpredictable predictable
Ability to rapidly build credibility with engineers, customers, and partners, and to quickly learn new technical domains
Comfort working with geographically distributed partners across regions and time zones
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science / related fields or equivalent work experience

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience operating more than one class of data service (for example a distributed database, a streaming or messaging system, a search platform, an in-memory store, or a consensus/coordination service)
Experience leading control plane services for managing data plane infrastructure
Understanding of distributed systems and database concepts (consistency models, isolation levels, replication and consensus protocols, crash and recovery semantics)
Performance engineering (design concepts, profile-guided optimization)
Service management and migrations across virtualized (EC2) and containerized (Kubernetes) platforms
Fundamentals of system-level hardware and networking components (storage devices and controllers, network interfaces, CPU and memory layout in server-class systems)
Operating systems concepts (process scheduling, disk and network I/O, performance)
Datacenter architecture (networking topologies, host placement strategies, and failure modes); design of multi-datacenter systems; failure domains; and wide-area networking
Experience building out a new engineering site or establishing a team in a new location
Prior experience with development or maintenance of distributed databases, streaming systems, or storage systems

Apple-200685591.full_text:
Apple's Services Engineering organization (ASE) is seeking an experienced data systems engineering manager to join our Databases SRE organization. The organization is expanding its footprint into Shanghai and is seeking an experienced engineering manager to build out and lead this site.  The Databases SRE organization is responsible for the full portfolio of database and data service technologies that Apple's internet services are built on, Apache Cassandra, Apache Kafka, Apache Solr, Redis/Valkey, etcd and other coordination services, and the platforms that run them. This is a cross-service role from day one: you will build and lead a team accountable for the reliability, scalability, and performance of all of these technologies as operated from the Shanghai site, and act as the site lead for the Databases SRE organization there.

ASE Databases SRE teams develop applications and tooling that are safe, reliable, scalable, and fast. This work requires an innovative spirit and an extraordinary degree of care and rigor in engineering. Team members contribute to all major components of our data service deployment infrastructure, including maintenance automation, backup services, monitoring and alerting tooling and dashboards, deployment architecture, and upstream contributions to the open source projects we run, focused on stability, performance, and scaling.  The team's work is deployed at massive scale, serving millions of queries per second over hundreds of petabytes of data across our data centers worldwide. It also has big impact, forming the platform upon which iCloud and many other internet services at Apple are built. In ASE, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users and is critical to the success of some of the most visible current and future Apple features.  This is a hands-on leadership role. We are seeking a manager with real domain experience who is comfortable working in the details, setting technical direction across several data service technologies rather than a single one, while building a new site from the ground up.

Hire, lead, develop, and grow a team of Site Reliability Engineers supporting Apple's data service platforms: Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Redis/Valkey, and coordination services such as etcd and zookeeper
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of these mission-critical data platforms as operated from the Shanghai site
Act as site lead for the Databases SRE organization in Shanghai, growing the site's scope and capability over time
Set technical direction for automation and scaling initiatives that apply across the portfolio rather than to a single technology
Drive incident response, post-incident reviews, and the systemic improvements that reduce operational toil
Establish and refine SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and change management
Manage and participate in on-call rotations and ensure sustainable, well-supported operational coverage
Partner with software engineering, Core Storage, and Analytics teams to influence system design for reliability, scalability, and operability
Engage internal platform customers with a high degree of customer focus, building credibility with engineers and partners across Apple

Apple-200682668.title: Decision Scientist
Apple-200682668.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.  

Do you have a strong passion for using data to drive business decisions, generate ideas, and inspire collaborators? As a Decision Scientist on the Retail Store Analytics team, you will play an integral role in helping Apple Retail make decisions using data. Design, refine, and create innovative analyses. Leverage large and complex data sources from across Apple to deliver data products.

You will partner with cross-functional teams to identify, frame, prioritize, and answer business questions where analytics can be most impactful. Design and implement analytics and reporting tools to support key decisions on a wide variety of topics including product launches, customer experience, and operational performance. Other responsibilities include the following: 
Design, create, refine, and maintain analyses and reporting.
Collaborate with other decision scientists, analysts, and engineers to build full-service data solutions.
Perform all aspects of analysis including data manipulation, programming, data visualization, documentation, and presentation of results.
Develop a deep understanding of our retail customer base and purchase choices and contribute to the development of tools to improve business efficiency and productivity.

Analyze large volumes of data; extract and manipulate large datasets using tools such as SQL, dbt, command line and scripting languages.
Analyze data covering a wide range of information from financial reporting to device purchase patterns such as export and trader activity and identify new patterns through data mining.
Design, develop, validate and maintain ad hoc as well as foundational performance analyses and business reporting 
Use data observability tools to develop and manage and automate testing, alerting and improve data quality.
Collaborate with data and business stakeholders to translate business needs into project requirements and communicate complex concepts and the results of the analyses in a clear and effective manner to business partners.
Strong collaborative technical experience, including using version control, release management, requirements gathering, data testing and documentation.
Apple-200682668.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
4+ years of related work experience in decision/data science, consulting, business analytics, or other related business facing role
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Engineering, Data Science, Business) or equivalent experience
4+ years experience coding in SQL and Python
4+ years experience performing rigorous statistical analysis
Ability to initiate, refine, and complete projects with minimal guidance
Ability to think critically and and collaborate cross-functionally with other analytics and business stakeholders to distill business questions into concise analyses and reports.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
2+ years of experience performing machine learning and predictive modeling
Experience translating business needs into logic and key performance indicators
Experience with BI processes and some experience with dashboard tools like Tableau
Master’s degree in a relevant field (Engineering, Data Science, Business) or equivalent experience

Apple-200676030.title: DevOps Engineer
Apple-200676030.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.  IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Sales and Operations Engineering is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's global operations, sales, and supply chain. The team connects the systems that move products from factory to customer — bridging sales platforms with the operational infrastructure that keeps Apple running at scale and ensuring Apple's technology and business priorities move in lockstep.

DevOps Engineer is responsible for supporting and enhancing our on-premises infrastructure through automation, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and infrastructure management. This role partners closely with development, Architects, and infrastructure teams to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, and deployment processes. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, proactive, and takes ownership of delivering secure, scalable, resillient, and maintainable solutions while continuously identifying opportunities for process improvement.
Apple-200676030.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
4+ years of experience in DevOps supporting Linux-based on-premise environments.
Strong experience administering Linux operating systems.
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Proficiency with Git and Git-based workflows.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or work related experience

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with source control management using Git, including branching, merging, pull requests, and release versioning.
Experience building and maintaining end-to-end CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as Git, Maven, Jenkins, Docker.
Experience building Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Ansible, and enterprise platform CLIs and SDKs for infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
Hands-on experience using Python to automate routine Operational tasks.
Solid understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, VLANs, load balancing, firewalls, and SSL/TLS.
Experience with observability tools, including monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana), logging (Splunk), and alerting/incident management (Alertmanager, PagerDuty).
Hands-on experience with Docker and container-based application deployment in enterprise on-premises environments is a plus.
Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies and apply relevant solutions to improve delivery velocity, automation, observability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Experience with Kafka, VectorDB, RDMBS and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra and/or Oracle) is a Huge Plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
Adaptable to changing priorities and evolving business requirements.

Apple-200682865.title: DevOps Engineer - Emerging Technologies
Apple-200682865.description:
Do you like to solve complex problems in order to delight customers? Want to work side-by-side with passionate and talented people who love their jobs? 

Do you like the excitement of a start-up, but the stability of an established company? Are you looking to be part of a team focussed on implementing and maintaining highly scalable, low-latency, distributed enterprise platforms. 

You'll need to have excellent communication and cross-group collaboration skills, be able to make forward progress despite ambiguous circumstances, be a self starter, a quick learner of new technologies and have experience shipping products. You will be a critical part of the DevOps/SRE team for a high-performing, low latency enterprise application. You will be responsible for planning and design of new infrastructure, contributing to the deployment architecture of core functionality and future planning for this exciting endeavor.  We need someone who is something of a generalist - a savant who can work on load balancers one day and optimize database performance the next. The ideal candidate has a strong mix of education and practical experience, and loves diving in to interesting problems head first. 

This role requires your to operate, monitor, and triage applications in the production and non-production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance across its low-latency, active/active cloud infrastructure.

The role will requires you to architect, build, and own robust CI/CD pipelines and automation systems, from design through long-term maintenance.

Operate, monitor, and triage applications in the production and non-production environments, ensuring reliability across its low-latency, Active/Active, and cloud infrastructure.

Independently architecting, building, and owning robust CI/CD pipelines and automation systems, from design through long-term maintenance.

Owning the reliability, scalability, and performance of high-availability, globally distributed cloud infrastructure powering Apple.

Designing, implementing, and continuously improving observability and alerting strategy across services, including defining SLOs/SLIs.

Collaborate with cross functional partner teams to align execution with team and org goals.
Apple-200682865.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability engineering.

Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go or Java.

Experience operating and supporting applications across cloud infrastructure ( eg, AliCoud, AWS and GCP).

Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, and Helm.

Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

Good command on Linux, networking concepts (TLS/SSL, DNS, Load Balancers, etc.,) and troubleshooting skills in large scale environments

Exposure to AI-assisted or AI-infused automation in DevOps workflows (e.g., using LLM-based tools, copilots, or intelligent agents for scripting, incident triage, or pipeline optimization).

Hands on experience in one or more databases (Relational / NoSQL like Oracle, MongoDB). Experience managing large Databases with very high transaction rates. Knowledge of Oracle Database architecture and replication.

Hands-on experience with Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.

BS or MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent education/experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
8 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering, with a proven track record of independently owning complex systems or initiatives from start to finish.

Extensive experience architecting and operating multi-region, high-availability infrastructure across AliCloud, AWS and GCP, with ownership of cloud cost, resilience, and scaling strategy.

Proven ownership of build/release systems and CI/CD pipelines at scale, including designing pipeline architecture, improving reliability, and reducing release friction.

Proven experience in Terraform, Pulumi, and Helm, including designing reusable modules and adopting organizational-level IaC standards.

Proven ability to operate with minimal direction: scoping ambiguous problems, proposing architecture, executing, and being accountable for outcomes.

Hands-on experience designing and building AI-powered automation for DevOps, including LLM-powered runbooks, autonomous remediation agents, anomaly detection pipelines, and AI-assisted code/infra review tools, with a proven track record of team adoption.

Apple-200681883.title: Display Engineer
Apple-200681883.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, phenomenal ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish. Apple Inc. is looking for a Display Engineer for the development and qualification of Displays for Apple Watch & iPhone products. This individual will be working on flat panel displays both at the component and system level, serving as a focal point between the system design team, the display EE team, display mechanical team, the supply base management team, and the display suppliers, managing all activities vital to deliver displays into final products from initial concept to production.

Integral part of an internal multi-functional team working with team members across optical, EE, ME, process and panel design expertise. 
Perform display inspection and review test results from display quality inspection, system OEMs, and multi-functional groups at Apple to ensure the performance specifications are met. 
Track all open engineering issues and help drive them to closure with efficiency to support project needs. 
Support engineering builds at display and system integration sites. Audit the processes and lead factory experiments to address issues. Drive and track failure analysis with suppliers, Apple and external FA labs.
