MS or BS in EE or Physics,  technical experience in a subset of the following fields: optical design and characterization, optical and/or human visual physics, semiconductor optoelectronics, display technologies, optical sensor technologies, circuits.
Experience supporting engineering builds at display and system integration sites. 
Experience auditing assembly and test processes, with track record of driving failure analysis with suppliers, and external FA labs.
Excellent project management, communication and collaboration skills.
Willingness and ability to travel.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
With up to 5 years of proven experience working in a display related field is preferred.
An in-depth understanding of display measurement and performance evaluation, display technologies, display module construction, process development and display systems.

Apple-200680314.title: Display Module Engineer
Apple-200680314.description:
Are you passionate about innovative display technology and precision engineering? Apple’s iPad & Mac Display Module team is seeking a talented and driven Display Engineer to lead the development of cutting-edge flat panel displays from initial concept through mass production. In this role, you will serve as a key technical interface between system teams, display electrical and optical engineering, mechanical engineering, and global supply partners. You will own the end-to-end development of display modules—driving design, validation, and integration to ensure industry-leading visual experiences for millions of users worldwide.

As a Display Engineer on the iPad & Mac team based in China, you will play a central role in defining, developing, and validating next-generation display technologies. You will collaborate closely with internal cross-functional engineering teams—including Optical, Electrical, Mechanical, Process, Reliability, and Panel Architecture engineers—while serving as the primary technical driver and authority with external display suppliers and final assembly manufacturing partners. You will champion module-level execution, drive technical risk mitigation, and translate product design intent into high-volume manufacturing success.

Define Module Architecture & Specifications: Define, review, and validate overall display module specifications, stack-up architectures, and performance criteria, with a strong focus on advanced OLED and LCD panel technologies.
Data-Driven Analysis & DOE Execution: Review and analyze design and process datasets to detect failure patterns; design and lead rigorous Design of Experiments (DOEs) to optimize manufacturing windows and establish clear paths forward.
Define Front-of-Screen (FOS) Metrics: Characterize, define, and standardize display FOS visual defect signatures and optical performance metrics during product development at vendor and final assembly sites.
Hands-on Failure Analysis (FA) & Root Cause Resolution: Lead deep-dive failure analysis for module-level and system-level reliability test failures; pinpoint root causes and design robust mitigation and corrective action plans.
Validation & Performance Characterization: Own and execute comprehensive module validation plans, conducting hands-on optical, mechanical, and electrical characterization to verify compliance with Apple standards.
Technology Exploration & Innovation: Investigate state-of-the-art flat panel display technologies, novel materials, and advanced fabrication processes to continuously advance Apple display performance and user experience.
On-Site & Build Support: Support engineering builds, line qualifications, and mass production ramp at supplier and manufacturing sites (travel required).
Bridge Design & Manufacturing: Act as the critical technical interface between system engineering teams and manufacturing partners, ensuring clear alignment and rapid execution from engineering builds through mass production.
Apple-200680314.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Optics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related engineering field.
10+ years of hands-on engineering experience in display technology development, display module integration, optical system engineering, or semiconductor optoelectronics.
Demonstrated track record of leading display products through full development lifecycles (NPI: concept, prototyping, engineering builds, validation, and mass production ramp).
Strong practical experience in statistical data analysis, Design of Experiments (DOE), and hands-on Failure Analysis (FA) across optical, electrical, and mechanical domains.
Proven ability to manage technical deliverables, solve complex engineering problems under tight timelines, and drive external vendor accountability.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Mandarin (written and verbal), with the ability to summarize complex technical findings for executive decision-making.
Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally to support builds and ramp at supplier sites.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
MS or PhD in Optics, Physics, EE, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
Proven track record in OLED panel architecture, TFT/backplane design, driving circuits, and display module process development in high-volume consumer electronics.
In-depth expertise in optical and display performance characterization, including hands-on proficiency with bench-top and industry-standard optical measurement instrumentation (e.g., spectroradiometers, 2D colorimeters).
Direct experience collaborating with mainstream global LCD / OLED panel suppliers and Tier-1 contract manufacturers (CMs).
Strong understanding of mechanical tolerance stack-up, display lamination processes, adhesive/material technologies, and system-level integration.

Apple-200685033.title: Display Optical In-Region Engineer
Apple-200685033.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. When you bring your passion and dedication to your team, there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Apple’s Hardware Technology group is seeking an experienced Display Opto-Mechanical Engineer to support the development, integration, and qualification of next-generation display modules and future technologies. In this role, you will collaborate closely with internal engineering teams and manufacturing partners, focusing on module integration spanning optics, display systems, and opto-mechanical assembly to help bring innovative hardware designs into high-volume production.

As a Display Opto-Mechanical Engineer, you will drive the integration, validation, and yield maturity of cutting-edge display modules across development builds through mass production. You will serve as a key technical partner with suppliers and cross-functional teams, solving complex opto-mechanical challenges at the interface of panels, optical stacks, and structural enclosures. Through rigorous data analysis, hands-on failure analysis, and on-site vendor engagement, you will ensure our displays meet Apple’s exacting standards for optical performance and product reliability.

Display Module & Integration: Lead module-level integration across the display panel, optical stack layers, adhesives, and mechanical housing. Optimize interface robustness against interfacial shear, CTE mismatch, warpage, and lamination defects. Drive opto-mechanical assembly process development and optimization with vendors to establish stable, high-yielding integration processes.
FOS Evaluation & Optical Defect Analysis: Own on-site front-of-screen (FOS) optical evaluations, establish boundary samples and defect criteria across build phases. Lead end-to-end failure analysis on optical anomalies, cosmetic fallout, and display performance shifts induced by module assembly and system integration. Review build data to identify issues and drive corrective actions to improve yield and performance.
Supplier Technical Management & Quality Closed-Loop: Serve as Apple's primary in-region technical representative at display and module assembly vendors, owning day-to-day engineering communication and issue resolution. Direct module vendors and contract manufacturers on critical process parameters, DOE execution, and inline inspection metrology. Apple-200679405.title: Display Supply Quality Engineer Intern
Apple-200679405.description:
Imagine what you could do hereAt Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don't just build products - they create the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. 

Join Apple as an intern and help us leave the world better than we found it!We are looking for a SQE Intern (Supply Quality Engineer) to support quality activities from development through mass production. In this internship, as a display SQE intern, you will learn and collaborate with senior engineers to drive technical direction and deliver scalable, high-quality display solutions for award-winning Apple products.

In this internship role, you will assist in quality system and tool development across New Product Introduction (NPI) and supplier execution phases. You will participate in evaluating new product designs and process specifications to ensure process capability, alignment with yield targets, and seamless scalability to mass production. Working alongside cross-functional engineering teams and key suppliers, you will contribute to failure analysis,corrective action implementation, and yield bridge strategies. Additionally, you will support reviews of supplier quality control plans, reliability testing,and in-process controls to prevent system interaction issues. You will collaborate with supplier technical teams to track Critical to Quality (CTQ) parameters, evaluate production readiness, and monitor yield loss across manufacturing nodes during production ramp.

Assist in driving overall quality system and quality control tool development to deliver
scalable products from development through mass production.
Participate in identifying technical challenges and reviewing new product designs, process configurations, and specifications to ensure scalability and alignment with process capability and yield targets.
Prepare timely, concise reports and presentations for product yield performance, failure analysis (FA), and specification convergence status.
Support Failure Analysis (FA), Corrective Action implementation plans, and yield bridging to mass production and future projects.
Review supplier quality control flows, in-process quality control systems, component and product quality control plans, and reliability testing, aligning with system test plans to prevent interaction issues.
Collaborate with supplier process and quality teams to map out process development exercises, track Critical to Quality (CTQ) parameters, secure FA resources, and improve yields in line with program goals.
Support technical direction provided to suppliers to establish and validate process capabilities and conduct risk assessments.
Assist in assessing supplier production readiness for build events and production ramps, identifying potential execution issues and suggesting mitigation options.
Monitor supplier process performance and yield loss across process nodes periodically to prevent quality issues.
Apple-200679405.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently enrolled in an MS or PhD program (or advanced BS) in Engineering,Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Academic or internship background with exposure to manufacturing, engineering, or operations principles.
Familiarity with data analysis, programming languages (Python, R, or SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Foundational coursework or knowledge of Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning and Data Science concepts.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Academic research or coursework in display technologies, such as LCD, OLED, micro OLED, or micro LED front-end or back-end processes.
Hands-on project, lab, or internship experience in development, process engineering, testing, or quality background within display, semiconductor, or electronics domains.
Demonstrated capability or coursework to plan DOEs, analyze in-process data, perform failure analysis (across EE, Optical, Mechanical, or Panel domains), and identify yield/quality improvement pathways.
Interest in researching and certifying new materials, and learning/developing quality tools and testing methods.
Self-starter mindset and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
Ability to travel up to 50% as required by program needs.

Apple-200680592.title: EPM Manager, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Program Management, Apple Services Engineering
Apple-200680592.description:
Apple Services Engineering team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long-held passion for combining art and technology. We are seeking an experienced engineering program management leader to join Apple Service Engineering’s in support of the SRE organization. In this role you will lead a team of program managers who thrive in a fast-paced workplace where drive and collaboration are the keys to success.   This is not just a task-based role; you are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. Strong fundamentals are a requirement! The SRE team is responsible for service infrastructure that ensures our customers’ flawless experience. You will partner with the SRE team to define, prioritize, plan, and deliver the project portfolio of technical, infrastructure, and system needs that make Apple, Apple. The projects range from deploying end to end infrastructure environments, hardware deployments, decommissions, complex system changes, tech refreshes, data migrations, service outage remediation, CapEx planning, as well as continually striving to scale & grow operations and improve operational standard methodologies.   ABOUT YOU: You feel a personal stake in the services you support and programs you define and lead. You have a deep well of positive energy and unbound passion. You hold yourself to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. You have unshakable integrity. You’re always asking why. You are as comfortable presenting to execs as you are with your nose in a burn down chart. You have deep wisdom and judgment. You know what success looks like. You seek a dynamic fast paced and sophisticated environment that will help define and deliver the infrastructure, software, security, and system needs that make Apple, Apple.

As a member of the ASE Program Management team, you will be on a team that serves the passions and needs of tens of millions of customers in an increasingly security-conscious world, so we’re looking for somebody who can be equally passionate! Key to your success will be to act as a business product thought problem solver on applicable domains, analyzing business risks, needs and requirements, participating and representing as the need arises in problem solving and design of engineering discussions.

This people leadership role requires you to build trust with engineering partners and persistently remove ambiguity by seeking to reduce complexity. 
You will play a pivotal role in developing a broad organizational perspective while facilitating & executing on strategic decisions. 
Additionally, you will support the development of process improvement and standard operating procedures in order to achieve maturity and effectiveness in engineering programs, all while leading and growing teams of extraordinary project managers. 
Systems within this scope are complex, so you will not only be expected to be able to readily understand complicated and subtle interdependencies, but also to evaluate new requests and new information in light of these systems. 
Being able to think on your feet is important, as is the ability to thoughtfully and efficiently debate the validity of a given approach to any aspect of a project under your control. 
Needless to say, strong social and interpersonal skills are required for this leadership role.

10+ years of program management experience in infrastructure domain
Strong background in software delivery, and services infrastructure engineering

Successful experience managing technical / engineering program management teams, hiring excellent people, and building impactful teams
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science / Engineering or deep relevant industry experience

Proven self-starter, who is dedicated and demonstrates creative and critical thinking abilities.
Excellent written & verbal communication skills, along with polished presentation skills
Self-motivated and proactive with proven creative & critical thinking capabilities
Expertise in coordination & participation in requirements gathering and design brainstorming sessions
Experience leading multiple complex projects simultaneously
A history of leadership, decision-making, negotiation skills, and ability to influence partners without direct authority
Prior engineering, infrastructure, or software development project management experience for Site Reliability Engineering / DevOps strongly preferred
Experience in the capacity management space

In this role you will lead a team of program managers who thrive in a fast-paced workplace where drive and collaboration are the keys to success.   

This is not just a task-based role; you are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. Strong fundamentals are a requirement! The SRE team is responsible for service infrastructure that ensures our customers’ flawless experience. You will partner with the SRE team to define, prioritize, plan, and deliver the project portfolio of technical, infrastructure, and system needs that make Apple, Apple. The projects range from deploying end to end infrastructure environments, hardware deployments, decommissions, complex system changes, tech refreshes, data migrations, service outage remediation, CapEx planning, as well as continually striving to scale & grow operations and improve operational standard methodologies.   

ABOUT YOU: You feel a personal stake in the services you support and programs you define and lead. You have a deep well of positive energy and unbound passion. You hold yourself to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. You have unshakable integrity. You’re always asking why. You are as comfortable presenting to execs as you are with your nose in a burn down chart. You have deep wisdom and judgment. You know what success looks like. You seek a dynamic fast paced and sophisticated environment that will help define and deliver the infrastructure, software, security, and system needs that make Apple, Apple.

As a member of the ASE Program Management team, you will be on a team that serves the passions and needs of tens of millions of customers in an increasingly security-conscious world, so we’re looking for somebody who can be equally passionate! Key to your success will be to act as a business product thought problem solver on applicable domains, analyzing business risks, needs and requirements, participating and representing as the need arises in problem solving and design of engineering discussions.

This people leadership role requires you to build trust with engineering partners and persistently remove ambiguity by seeking to reduce complexity. 
You will play a pivotal role in developing a broad organizational perspective while facilitating & executing on strategic decisions. 
Additionally, you will support the development of process improvement and standard operating procedures in order to achieve maturity and effectiveness in engineering programs, all while leading and growing teams of extraordinary project managers. 
Systems within this scope are complex, so you will not only be expected to be able to readily understand complicated and subtle interdependencies, but also to evaluate new requests and new information in light of these systems. 
Being able to think on your feet is important, as is the ability to thoughtfully and efficiently debate the validity of a given approach to any aspect of a project under your control. 
Needless to say, strong social and interpersonal skills are required for this leadership role.

Apple-200680572.description:

Apple-200681954.title: Engineering Manager - ASE Data Services
Apple-200681954.description:
Join ASE Data Services and help build and evolve the databases that power Apple's services at massive scale. We build and run high-performance, distributed datastores, relying heavily on open source technologies and contributing back to the projects we depend on.

In this role, you will lead a talented group of engineers based in China who are matrix-embedded (dotted line) into various global Data Services teams. You will play a pivotal role in bridging local operations with our broader Data Services leadership outside of China, ensuring your team delivers world-class distributed datastores and database proxy solutions. If you are an exceptional communicator with a deep background in software engineering, database technologies, and impactful people management, this is your opportunity to shine!

As a leader in this organization, you will lead and empower a team of skilled engineers designing, building, and operating cutting-edge features for large-scale distributed database systems, to support Apple’s operations in China. Your team members will be embedded across multiple Data Services squads, working on everything from client libraries and high-performance proxy services to core database engines and control planes.

People Management & Local Operations: Act as the primary manager and mentor for engineers in China. You will be crucial in navigating local compliances, regulations, and work cultures, while fostering an environment of collaboration, inclusivity, and technical excellence.
Global Alignment: Collaborate effectively with broader Data Services leadership outside of China. You will ensure strategic alignment, clear communication, and seamless integration of your embedded ICs within global initiatives.
Technical Leadership: Draw on your prior software engineering experience to evaluate trade-offs in distributed systems, understand database architectures, and ensure high standards for availability, consistency, performance, and security.
Impact & Delivery: Drive engineering best practices, performance tuning, and operational excellence for platforms powering hundreds of millions of Apple users worldwide.
Team Development: Evolve the team's processes and values, providing technical guidance, encouraging career growth in a dotted-line matrix structure, and promoting a healthy work-life balance.
Apple-200681954.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software engineering with a proven track record of technical impact.
3+ years of engineering management experience, successfully leading high-performing software development teams.
Strong understanding of databases, data services, and distributed systems fundamentals (e.g., relational, NoSQL, data replication, caching).
Exceptional communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively across time zones, bridging local teams with global, cross-functional leadership.
Deep expertise in people management, with an understanding of local HR compliances, regulations, and team advocacy.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience managing engineers in a matrixed or embedded model (dotted line reporting) across multiple global workstreams.
8+ years of total experience in software engineering, specifically within highly scalable distributed services.
Hands-on experience building and operating distributed databases or storage systems at scale (e.g., Cassandra, Kafka, Redis, Zookeeper).
Familiarity with capacity planning, observability, and performance tuning for massive-scale stateful workloads.
Full product lifecycle ownership mindset (design → implementation → production) with experience navigating ambiguity in complex environments.
A history of driving initiatives that optimize developer experience, operational reliability, and large-scale data delivery.

Apple-200685827.title: Engineering Manager – SAP Technology & Cloud Platforms
Apple-200685827.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. By bringing passion, dedication, and technical excellence to your role, there is no telling what you could accomplish.
We are seeking an experienced and visionary Engineering Manager (MGR2) to lead our SAP Technology and Cloud Engineering organization in Shanghai. In this critical technical leadership capacity, you will lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of Apple engineers and managed service partners across SAP BTP, Basis & HANA Database Administration, Cloud/DevOps (Alibaba Cloud & AWS), Security & Governance, and End-to-End Performance Engineering.
Beyond organizational leadership, you will serve as the principal technical partner to regional and global SAP Track Managers.

As the SAP Technical Manager, you will be directly accountable for the foundational platform and infrastructure powering Apple's mission-critical enterprise workloads in China. This role uniquely blends hands-on engineering stewardship, 24x7 production resilience, cloud platform evolution, and external vendor governance.
You will lead from the front—setting architectural benchmarks, instilling operational rigor, and bridging technical capability with business enablement. You will establish trusted partnerships with functional process owners and global IS&T counterparts to ensure China’s SAP systems deliver unmatched reliability, performance, and compliance with enterprise security and regulatory standards.

1. People & Organizational Leadership
•	Lead & Mentor Engineering Talent: Direct, coach, and grow an elite team of engineers covering SAP Basis, SAP BTP Platform & Security, Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps, and HANA DB & Application Performance Engineering.
•	Hybrid Workforce & Vendor Governance: Oversee managed service providers, system integrators, and contractor staff. Define engineering standards, enforce Statements of Work (SOW), set KPIs/SLAs, and drive delivery excellence across outsourced engagements.
•	Engineering Culture: Champion technical curiosity, evidence-based problem solving, operational discipline, and a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
2. Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management
•	Business & Functional Synchronization: Serve as the primary technical liaison and trusted advisor to functional track managers across business domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Operations, Retail, Finance).
•	Release & Cutover Planning: Partner with functional leads on project roadmaps, enhancement cutovers, downtime scheduling, and integration timelines to achieve zero disruption to live operations.
•	Global & Regional Alignment: Partner with worldwide architecture, global Basis/BTP teams, and InfoSec to harmonize local architecture with corporate standards while addressing regional business requirements.
3. Platform Modernization & 24x7 Production Operations
•	High Availability & SLA Governance: Own the availability, disaster recovery (DR), and performance SLOs of China’s SAP production environments (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP, and associated microservices).
•	Hybrid Cloud & BTP Modernization: Drive the evolutionary roadmap from traditional infrastructure to modern hybrid architectures leveraging SAP BTP (Integration Suite, Kyma/Cloud Foundry, Advanced Event Mesh) and hyperscalers (primarily Alibaba Cloud).
•	Major Incident Leadership: Direct critical P1/P2 production incident triage, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventative engineering across Basis, database, network, and application tiers.
4. Security, Compliance & Performance Assurance
•	Security & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce stringent baseline security controls in partnership with InfoSec and Internal Audit: Identity and Access Management (GRC, SoD, SAML/SSO), data encryption, network segmentation, and China data handling and cybersecurity regulations.
•	Proactive Performance Engineering: Champion an evidence-based performance culture. Guide DB and BTP performance engineers in SQL tuning, PlanViz diagnostics, capacity modeling, stress testing, and observability (Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana).
Apple-200685827.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of progressive technical experience in SAP enterprise architecture, SAP Basis, or cloud platform engineering.
4+ years of direct people management experience leading technical engineering teams in large-scale, complex enterprise environments.
Proven track record leading hybrid teams combining direct FTEs and external vendor/managed service partners.
In-depth understanding of core SAP landscapes (S/4HANA, ECC, HANA Database Administration, High Availability, Disaster Recovery, System Replication).
Hands-on knowledge of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) ecosystems (Integration Suite, Cloud Foundry/Kyma runtimes, Event-Driven Architectures).
Familiarity with public hyperscaler infrastructure in China (especially Alibaba Cloud) and containerized/DevOps practices.
Operational Excellence: Demonstrated background managing 24x7 mission-critical enterprise production operations, change governance, and high-pressure incident remediation.
Stakeholder & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal, consensus-building, and cross-functional leadership skills across technical, functional, and leadership stakeholders. Professional fluency in both English and Mandarin (written and verbal).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience architecting, running, or migrating SAP systems hosted on Alibaba Cloud or multi-cloud environments.
Solid understanding of China-specific regulatory frameworks governing enterprise IT.
Experience with enterprise observability and telemetry stacks (Dynatrace, SAP Cloud ALM, Splunk, Grafana).
Strong grasp of modern DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), and automated testing frameworks.
Formal certifications: SAP BTP, SAP HANA, or Hyperscaler Cloud Architect (Alibaba Cloud / AWS).

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Engineering Manager (MGR2) to lead our SAP Technology and Cloud Engineering organization in Shanghai. In this critical technical leadership capacity, you will lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of Apple engineers and managed service partners across SAP BTP, Basis & HANA Database Administration, Cloud/DevOps (Alibaba Cloud & AWS), Security & Governance, and End-to-End Performance Engineering.
Beyond organizational leadership, you will serve as the principal technical partner to regional and global SAP Track Managers.

As the SAP Technical Manager, you will be directly accountable for the foundational platform and infrastructure powering Apple's mission-critical enterprise workloads in China. This role uniquely blends hands-on engineering stewardship, 24x7 production resilience, cloud platform evolution, and external vendor governance.
You will lead from the front—setting architectural benchmarks, instilling operational rigor, and bridging technical capability with business enablement. You will establish trusted partnerships with functional process owners and global IS&T counterparts to ensure China’s SAP systems deliver unmatched reliability, performance, and compliance with enterprise security and regulatory standards.

1. People & Organizational Leadership
•	Lead & Mentor Engineering Talent: Direct, coach, and grow an elite team of engineers covering SAP Basis, SAP BTP Platform & Security, Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps, and HANA DB & Application Performance Engineering.
•	Hybrid Workforce & Vendor Governance: Oversee managed service providers, system integrators, and contractor staff. Define engineering standards, enforce Statements of Work (SOW), set KPIs/SLAs, and drive delivery excellence across outsourced engagements.
•	Engineering Culture: Champion technical curiosity, evidence-based problem solving, operational discipline, and a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
2. Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management
•	Business & Functional Synchronization: Serve as the primary technical liaison and trusted advisor to functional track managers across business domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Operations, Retail, Finance).
•	Release & Cutover Planning: Partner with functional leads on project roadmaps, enhancement cutovers, downtime scheduling, and integration timelines to achieve zero disruption to live operations.
•	Global & Regional Alignment: Partner with worldwide architecture, global Basis/BTP teams, and InfoSec to harmonize local architecture with corporate standards while addressing regional business requirements.
3. Platform Modernization & 24x7 Production Operations
•	High Availability & SLA Governance: Own the availability, disaster recovery (DR), and performance SLOs of China’s SAP production environments (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP, and associated microservices).
•	Hybrid Cloud & BTP Modernization: Drive the evolutionary roadmap from traditional infrastructure to modern hybrid architectures leveraging SAP BTP (Integration Suite, Kyma/Cloud Foundry, Advanced Event Mesh) and hyperscalers (primarily Alibaba Cloud).
•	Major Incident Leadership: Direct critical P1/P2 production incident triage, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventative engineering across Basis, database, network, and application tiers.
4. Security, Compliance & Performance Assurance
•	Security & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce stringent baseline security controls in partnership with InfoSec and Internal Audit: Identity and Access Management (GRC, SoD, SAML/SSO), data encryption, network segmentation, and China data handling and cybersecurity regulations.
•	Proactive Performance Engineering: Champion an evidence-based performance culture. Guide DB and BTP performance engineers in SQL tuning, PlanViz diagnostics, capacity modeling, stress testing, and observability (Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana).

Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of progressive technical experience in SAP enterprise architecture, SAP Basis, or cloud platform engineering.
4+ years of direct people management experience leading technical engineering teams in large-scale, complex enterprise environments.
Proven track record leading hybrid teams combining direct FTEs and external vendor/managed service partners.
In-depth understanding of core SAP landscapes (S/4HANA, ECC, HANA Database Administration, High Availability, Disaster Recovery, System Replication).
Hands-on knowledge of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) ecosystems (Integration Suite, Cloud Foundry/Kyma runtimes, Event-Driven Architectures).
Familiarity with public hyperscaler infrastructure in China (especially Alibaba Cloud) and containerized/DevOps practices.
Operational Excellence: Demonstrated background managing 24x7 mission-critical enterprise production operations, change governance, and high-pressure incident remediation.
Stakeholder & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal, consensus-building, and cross-functional leadership skills across technical, functional, and leadership stakeholders. Professional fluency in both English and Mandarin (written and verbal).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience architecting, running, or migrating SAP systems hosted on Alibaba Cloud or multi-cloud environments.
Solid understanding of China-specific regulatory frameworks governing enterprise IT.
Experience with enterprise observability and telemetry stacks (Dynatrace, SAP Cloud ALM, Splunk, Grafana).
Strong grasp of modern DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), and automated testing frameworks.
Formal certifications: SAP BTP, SAP HANA, or Hyperscaler Cloud Architect (Alibaba Cloud / AWS).

Apple-200694686.description:

The Apple unboxing experience is iconic and sets the stage for the products our
customers love. We are looking for a highly motivated Packaging EPM to lead the
development of our world-class packaging, balancing structural integrity, premium
aesthetics, and our industry-leading environmental and sustainability goals.

The Packaging EPM is a hands-on programmatic role where you and your team will be
responsible for delivering the packaging structures and assemblies through the entire
program life cycle, from early design to mass production. It includes frequent multi-
disciplinary collaboration with teams like Packaging Product Design, Industrial Design,
Marketing, Environmental Technologies, Materials, and Operations. You will be responsible
for driving the program through the entire development process, creating and maintaining
streamlined schedules, driving cross-functional progress, managing packaging builds at
factories, and presenting multiple levels of status updates to organizational leaders and
executives.

Drive the strategic execution of packaging design, ensuring alignment with overall project goals, unboxing experience standards, and sustainability targets.
Lead the creation of and adherence to project schedules, ensuring key decision milestones are met across all phases. Go beyond holding teams accountable by actively guiding, anticipating roadblocks, and pushing cross-functional groups toward the most eﬀective engineering paths.
Manage budgets, track spending, and ensure financial prudence, proactively identifying appropriate scope drivers and their cost implications.
Facilitate clear and consistent communication and alignment between internal teams and external partners, ensuring everyone is working towards the same goals.
Provide strong leadership and support during build phases, ensuring timely delivery. Build strategic partnerships focused on elevating vendor capabilities.
Coach their teams on how to execute NPI builds to Apple’s exacting standards, drive their continuous operational progress, and help them establish robust, world-class manufacturing workflows.
Oversee the release process, ensuring timely and accurate releases and holding teams accountable for meeting release deadlines.

Previous experience in program management. Packaging/mechanical engineering delivering products comprised of multiple materials (e.g., rigid boxes, molded fiber, paperboard, plastics, adhesives) will be preferred
Experience leading product development in highly dynamic and ambiguous work environments, supporting high-volume manufacturing and assembly.
Excellent communication, teamwork, cross-functional engagement, and strong presentation skills.
Ability to anticipate functional direction and roadblocks, prioritize parallel closure paths, eﬀectively distill and communicate relevant data to the appropriate functional and leadership teams.
Self-motivated and detail-oriented with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities.
Experience engaging with manufacturers on DFM, FAI/CPK, QC, and production timelines
BS degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent; MS degree preferred

5+ years of experience related to engineering program management of electrical devices industry
Wide knowledge of packaging development processes including detailed understanding of manufacturing processes (printing, die-cutting, forming, gluing) and tooling timelines.
Shipped multiple full life-cycle programs with demonstrated experience in early architecture, development build NPI execution, and operational mass-production.
Experience as primary point of contact with vendors and CM partners to establish a daily build plan, provide clear direction and guidance to meet the program and build objectives.

Apple-200690039.title: Engineering Program Manager Intern - Shanghai
Apple-200690039.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Just be ready to dream big. 

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Be a part of the Hardware Test Engineering (HWTE) program management team! The HWTE team is the critical link ensuring Apple's products meet the highest standards of quality and performance before reaching our customers. In this role, you will bring operational rigor, process optimization, and data-driven insights to our global test engineering initiatives. Working closely with cross-functional teams across hardware, software, operations, and external equipment partners, you will identify opportunities to streamline equipment delivery and help build the data foundation our organization relies on to make faster, smarter decisions.

As an Engineering Program Manager Intern on the Hardware Test Engineering (HWTE) team, you will support our engineering subject matter experts (SMEs) and program leads in improving design package quality, process efficiency, and operational visibility across our test equipment ecosystem. Working alongside hardware, software, and operations teams, you will help evaluate and standardize engineering documentation (such as CAD packages, 2D drawings, and specifications), investigate workflow and handoff bottlenecks between Apple and equipment suppliers, and assist in building data models and AI-assisted tools that enable smoother equipment bring-up across our global supplier network.

Design Package Quality & Global Transferability: Audit, score, and help standardize China-originated engineering documentation (CAD packages, 2D drawings, critical dimensions, GD&T, and specifications) against engineering rubrics so designs are complete, accurate, and transferable to global suppliers.
Process & Workflow Bottleneck Analysis: Map and analyze end-to-end fixture development workflows and Apple-supplier handoffs to identify schedule friction points, review cycle delays, and opportunities for process optimization.
Supplier Readiness & Integration Support: Assist Apple engineering SMEs in tracking supplier technical readiness, organizing design review feedback, and aligning vendor deliverables with Apple's test station architecture and integration requirements.
Data Foundations, AI Tooling & Reporting: Support the team in consolidating scattered trackers into structured datasets, piloting AI-assisted design review or telemetry tools, and preparing data-driven summaries and recommendations for HWTE leadership.
Travel: Travel domestically in China (and potentially internationally) up to 50% to manufacturing and vendor sites to support engineering reviews, documentation audits, and station bring-up.
Apple-200690039.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering Management, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (graduating within 0–6 months from the conclusion of the internship).
Available to complete a full-time 6-month internship in Shanghai, China.
Strong engineering fundamentals: ability to read technical drawings (2D/3D CAD), parse engineering specifications, and quickly learn electro-mechanical system architectures.
Practical experience using modern AI/ML productivity tools, data automation, scripting (e.g., Python), or dashboarding to structure and analyze engineering data.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail in auditing technical documentation and mapping workflows.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, in both English and Mandarin.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Prior internship, academic research, or project experience in hardware manufacturing, automated test equipment, robotics, or factory automation environments.
Exposure to test station architecture (fixtures, nests, sensors, pneumatics, controls), design for manufacturing (DFM), or geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
Familiarity with design review processes, CAD package auditing, or developing scoring rubrics / automated checklists for technical documentation.
A proactive, structured problem solver who works effectively with cross-functional subject matter experts to create clarity from ambiguity.
High attention to detail with strong multi-tasking and technical program coordination skills.

Apple-200666752.title: Engineering Project Manager
Apple-200666752.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
IS&T Asia Pacific (APAC) brings together all IS&T functions across the Asia Pacific region, partnering with global leadership to deliver key programs at a regional level. The team works closely with APAC business and sales teams, providing real-time visibility into how IS&T systems and tools are performing across the region.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives across engineering, compliance, business, product, and operations teams with a focus on engineering execution, compliance governance, audit readiness, and operational controls. In this role, you will drive high-impact programs from concept through delivery, partnering closely with engineering leaders, product owners, business stakeholders, and regional teams. You will bring structure to ambiguity, align teams around clear priorities, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure delivery of compliant, scalable, secure, and high-quality solutions.

This is a role for someone who can operate comfortably at both strategic and execution levels: able to engage senior leaders on roadmap, governance, and trade-offs, while also diving deep into technical details, project plans, risks, milestones, and operational readiness.

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex IS&T engineering programs across enterprise applications, systems,  compliance, infrastructure, platforms, and AI/ML initiatives.

Partner with engineering, compliance, product, business, privacy, legal, finance, operations, and regional stakeholders to define program scope, delivery plans, compliance governance, audit readiness, control requirements, and success metrics.

Translate regulatory, compliance, and audit requirements into structured engineering execution plans, including milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, evidence requirements, and operational readiness criteria.

Drive audit readiness by ensuring programs have clear documentation, decision records, control evidence, access governance, change management records, testing results, monitoring data, and post-launch support models.

Work with engineering teams to establish sustainable compliance mechanisms, such as system logging, monitoring, access control reviews, data flow traceability, operational dashboards, anomaly detection, and audit trails.

Manage cross-functional dependencies across global and regional teams, and prepare clear executive-level updates, audit summaries, audit readiness materials, risk reviews, and decision documents.
Apple-200666752.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
8+ years of experience in engineering project management, technical program management, compliance program management, audit readiness, enterprise systems delivery, or related roles.

Experience leading complex cross-functional technology programs involving software engineering, enterprise platforms, cloud infrastructure, compliance, or audit controls.

Ability to work with engineering teams to translate compliance or audit requirements into technical implementation plans.

Good understanding of audit and compliance concepts, including control design, control validation, evidence collection, risk assessment, remediation tracking, and governance reporting.

Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical, compliance, and audit topics clearly to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Good technical fluency, with the ability to understand system architecture, data flows, integration dependencies, security requirements, operational risks, and engineering trade-offs.

Strong ownership, attention to detail, ability to bring structure to ambiguity, and ability to influence across global teams.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience working with regulatory compliance, internal audit, external audit, personal data protection, data localization, data governance, controlled technology environments, regulatory reporting, post-approval continuous compliance and audit . 

Familiarity with enterprise application architecture, identity and access management, observability, DevOps, data platforms, data classification, audit trail requirements, and compliance automation.

Familiarity with regulatory-facing or audit-facing activities related to personal data protection, data localization, including preparation of technical documentation, data flow diagrams, evidence packages, remediation plans, and compliance status reporting.

Expert level communication skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate directly and clearly across engineering, business, legal, compliance, audit, and executive stakeholders. Strong emphasis on clarity, precision, active listening, and the ability to align diverse global teams around complex technical, regulatory, and operational topics.

Proven track record of bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous, fast-moving programs without introducing unnecessary process overhead.

Apple-200674049.title: Engineering Project Manager - Regulatory Management
Apple-200674049.description:
Apple is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Engineering Project Manager (EPM) / Program Manager to drive the execution of critical data and regulatory compliance initiatives in Greater China.  Reporting to the manager of Regulatory Management, you will be the operational engine behind our Cross Border Data Transfer (CBDT) filings and data security programs. You will work at the intersection of Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and Government Affairs, translating complex technical data flows into structured project plans and actionable deliverables. If you excel at bringing order to ambiguity and driving cross-functional alignment in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

BDT Program Execution: Manage the day-to-day project lifecycle for Cross Border Data Transfer (CBDT) security assessments and standard contract filings. Build and maintain detailed project schedules, track milestones, and ensure timely delivery of technical and legal documentation.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the central operational hub between global Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and regional Government Affairs (GA) teams. Facilitate working sessions to map technical data flows, cloud architectures, and system integrations required for regulatory submissions.
Infrastructure Localization Oversight: Drive the execution roadmap for enterprise-wide data localization and  facilitate IT infrastructure decoupling, overseeing milestones across different line of business.Facilitate deep-dive technical discussion to ensure solutions meet both strict regulatory requirement and Apple's privacy standards.

Reporting & Executive Support: Develop and maintain program dashboards, status reports, and risk trackers. Assist in preparing presentation materials and synthesizing project updates for to VP/ET-level leadership.
Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in the regulatory data-gathering and filing process. Design and implement streamlined workflows to improve the efficiency of how engineering and legal teams collaborate on compliance deliverables.
Apple-200674049.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Experience: 8+ years of experience in Engineering Project Management, Technical Program Management, or Compliance Operations within the technology sector.
Technical Literacy: Demonstrated ability to comprehend complex technical constraints and translate them into business impacts. Possess a strong understanding of enterprise system architectures, cloud infrastructure, complex data flows, and cybersecurity concepts (e.g., encryption, traffic sampling, secure proxies).
Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex, multi-threaded projects from inception to completion. Strong capability to lead without authority, drive cross-functional alignment, and hold diverse teams accountable to strict deadlines.
Analytical & Detail-Oriented:  Exceptional organizational capabilities with a meticulous approach to complex problem-solving. Demonstrated ability to synthesize, track, and execute against hundreds of intersecting technical data points, regulatory requirements, and project dependencies with zero margin for error.
Language: Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese (written and spoken) is mandatory, with the ability to accurately translate complex technical concepts between both languages.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems,Engineering or a related field. An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is highly preferred.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Domain Familiarity: Working knowledge of data privacy and cybersecurity principles. Leading large-scale digital transformation / cloud migration projects is a significant plus.
Technical Aptitude: Strong technical foundation with the ability to understand cloud infrastructure, data mapping, encryption standards, and software development lifecycles.
Regulatory Operations: Prior experience project managing government filings, regulatory audits, or compliance certifications (e.g., ISO, SOC, or local Chinese standards) in partnership with Legal or Government Affairs teams.
Certifications: PMP, Agile/Scrum certification, or privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPT).

If you are passionate about system architecture, enterprise integration, and driving technology projects from conception to completion, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

As an SAP Engineering Project Manager, you will lead the design, implementation, and integration of robust enterprise solutions that support Apple’s global supply chain and operations. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure technical specifications on the SAP platform. Define and design end-to-end system architectures on SAP Core, S/4HANA, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications.
Lead the technical design, deployment, and operation of integrations between internal SAP systems and external supply chain partner networks using modern integration frameworks (such as sFTP, EDI, APIs, XML, CPI, and BTP).
Collaborate with cross-functional business domains and external partners to establish project priorities, deliverables, and robust system designs aligned with operational targets.
Manage full-lifecycle project execution from partner selection and technical requirement documentation through to integration testing, global cutovers, go-live support, and handoff.
Guide and review the work of technical development teams, ensuring accuracy, security, encryption standards, and performance optimization are embedded in system designs.
Extend standard SAP capabilities through customization frameworks (such as user-exits, implicit enhancements, BADIs, and BAPIs) while ensuring compliance with IT standards and industry best practices.
Advise on architecture scalability and capacity planning for New Product Introductions (NPI) and peak business events, working closely with partner engineering groups.
Apple-200675601.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Technology, or equivalent practical experience in supply chain management.

Experience designing and delivering SAP techno-functional solutions in Service Management, Supply Chain Management, or Operations domains for B2B or consumer-facing environments.
Experience customizing, developing customization frameworks, and building end-to-end integrations within SAP Core and S/4HANA environments.
Experience managing complex, end-to-end global enterprise projects, including leading technical workshops, establishing partner integrations, and coordinating worldwide system cutovers.

Experience applying performance engineering principles to optimize system throughput, response times, and performance testing.
Experience analyzing and implementing security and encryption requirements for PII/PIC data handling.

Experience designing and utilizing test automation frameworks and tools to streamline regression and performance testing.

Experience developing custom solutions using Python, Java, JavaScript, or the Cloud Application Programming (CAP) framework on SAP BTP.

Experience leading technical scalability discussions, capacity planning, and risk mitigation for high-volume operational events.

We are seeking an SAP Engineering Project Manager to lead the execution of complex enterprise solutions for our Operations and Service Management domains. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical design, working closely with global, cross-functional teams in a highly customized, high-scale environment. If you are passionate about system architecture, enterprise integration, and driving technology projects from conception to completion, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

As an SAP Engineering Project Manager, you will lead the design, implementation, and integration of robust enterprise solutions that support Apple’s global supply chain and operations. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure technical specifications on the SAP platform. Your efforts will ensure high-performing, end-to-end process integrations across a highly integrated global landscape.

Define and design end-to-end system architectures on SAP Core, S/4HANA, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications.
Lead the technical design, deployment, and operation of integrations between internal SAP systems and external supply chain partner networks using modern integration frameworks (such as sFTP, EDI, APIs, XML, CPI, and BTP).
Collaborate with cross-functional business domains and external partners to establish project priorities, deliverables, and robust system designs aligned with operational targets.
Manage full-lifecycle project execution from partner selection and technical requirement documentation through to integration testing, global cutovers, go-live support, and handoff.
Guide and review the work of technical development teams, ensuring accuracy, security, encryption standards, and performance optimization are embedded in system designs.
Extend standard SAP capabilities through customization frameworks (such as user-exits, implicit enhancements, BADIs, and BAPIs) while ensuring compliance with IT standards and industry best practices.
Advise on architecture scalability and capacity planning for New Product Introductions (NPI) and peak business events, working closely with partner engineering groups.

Apple-200685364.description:

It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imagine what you could do here. Are you ready to take this challenge?

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

We’re a diverse collection of thinkers and doers, continually reimagining our products, systems, and practices to help people do what they love in new ways. This is a deeply reciprocal place, where everything we build is the result of people in different roles and teams working together to make each other’s ideas stronger. That same real passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it. The Facilities Engineer Lead possesses the skills and experience of a validated corporate real estate professional with good engineering knowledge and management skills. You will have a strong emphasis on handling multiple site operations consistent with a diversified portfolio. Ability to interact with Apple business functions & customers at all levels including management reporting.

You will report to Facility Engineering lead and work together with Facility Engineer (Mechanical) to oversee Engineering (Hard Service) aspects of Facilities Operation & Maintenance. You will manage service providers to create and implement maintenance processes and procedures for planned preventative work and reactive works to achieve smooth and innovated operation and maintenance services.

As a Facility Engineer (Electrical), you will report to Facility Engineer lead and be responsible for all operational duties on Engineering perspective within the Complex that are consistent with regional priorities and expected ends/results. The candidate will have extensive experience in a similar role with rich experience of preventative and reactive maintenance services.

* Day to day management of all installed Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, MEP) systems for the Shanghai R&D Site managed by Places – excludes OEM and Retail.
* Structure and oversee planned and preventative maintenance programs including supply of critical spares to optimise cost to Apple whilst ensuring operations and business continuity. 
* Own the financial control on Operation expense including Budget planning, Forecast tracking, regular Opex/Capex review.  
* Review building operations, and put for forward operational efficiencies, in an effort to stream line operations and reduce running costs.
* Own and drive key facilities engineering programs including but not limited to a). Asset register setup and management; b). MEP systems Risk Assessment and Auditing; c). MEP Systems Emergency Response Lead and Contingency Planning.
* Own and manage Small Works including planning, scheduling, cost control, deliverable with high quality outcome and well communication with end users.
* Managing from Operation and Engineering perspective to participate and contribute into Site handover, Design review, Testing and commissioning and acceptance, Project handover for all new corporate projects and initiatives managed by Places.
* Oversee Engineering systems to ensure on-going statutory compliance, Environmental accreditations and optimum performance against local and International norms and standards.
* Partner with Apple internal business partners (for instance, Global Energy Team) to develop energy management initiatives/projects and execute as approved.
* Manage equipment life cycle costing and performance evaluation. Drive Value Engineering initiatives and implement solutions accordingly.
* Management of matrixed teams of consultants, contractors and suppliers to deliver the Engineering maintenance scope of work as per agreed performance indicators.  This role will involve leading management of all Engineering supplier contracts and performance with other internal resources as required.
Apple-200685364.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Facility Management or related field from an accredited institution.
Associates Degree in Electrical Technology or Certificate Program in Facilities Management or Facilities Maintenance with 5+ Years of relevant business experience.
Experience with facility management of R&D Lab, Clean Room and/or Data Centre environment’s preferred.  
Experience in setting up and managing Planned Preventative and Reactive Maintenance Schedules.  
Experience in managing Small Works (engineering modification works) within a complex facility.
Great Building Engineering knowledge, experience, and management skills.
Self-starter and capable individual contributor.
Great communication and presentation skills – English and Mandarin

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Great engineering experience and facility management on R&D related facilities. 
Great organizational, presentation, verbal and written communication skills. 
Passionate about customer services and end-user experience.
Proficiency to work with CAD/BIM systems and interpret/review MEP design and construction drawings.
Understanding of Greater China codes and statutory requirements governing Engineering systems.

Apple-200692595.title: Field Security Technical Engineer
Apple-200692595.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together we build products and experiences people once couldn’t have envisioned — and now can’t imagine living without. If you’re excited by the idea of making an impact, joining a team where we pride ourselves in being one of the most diverse and expansive companies in the world, a career with Apple might be your dream job.

This role is for an ambitious Apple security initiative which aims to improve Apple internal and supply chain’s network. The main responsibility will be for the delivery of the latest network security system in a complicated environment, with combined technical skill and driving cross functional teams to achieve the goal.

Design, deploy, manage & support security appliances within various network environments with firewalls/IPS/IDS & Remote Access infrastructure in China/APAC region.
Build programmable scripts for automated network operation and monitoring document technical proposals and plan for internal/external knowledge transfer to align with SOP.
Act as DRI to respond to issues/queries from in-region production line and provide instant feedback to remote teams including SRE/R&D/EPM/HWTE.
Carry on duty-shift for network incidents and security issues in production.
Manage project results by working directly with business/vendors to quickly identify their needs and provide an appropriate solution in line with global standards.
Represent Asia-Pacific in any global/regional technical discussions or initiatives.
Provide formal and informal training, consulting and mentoring for vendors and/or team members as needed.
Apple-200692595.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Minimum of 5 years relevant work experience in a MNC or major national company.
Solid knowledge on computer network and common protocols, TCP/IP and OSI model, UDP, DNS,  SSH, SSL/TLS, HTTPS and various security technologies such as network and application firewalls, host intrusion prevention and anti-virus etc. 
Hands-on experience with analysis of network traffic, packet sniffer and usage of Deep Packet Inspection tools.
Programming proficiency, sufficient to write and execute scripts from the command line such as Python/Go etc. Experience on automation tools such as Ansible/Saltstack and Puppet.
Experience in installing, configuring & troubleshooting network routers, switches and firewall/ VPN devices.
Deep knowledge in operating system mechanism such as Darwin/Free BSD/WinNT/CE, experience in Unix-like Sys.
Excellent communication and influencing skills including verbal and written English. 
Exemplary paperwork and documentation skills ,strong ability to translate complex ideas into simple solutions on paper.
Able to travel extensively.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Thorough understanding of Content Delivery Networks and the integration applications.Knowledge & experience in networking technologies such as IPv6,Ethernet, VPLS, MPLS, ISDN, IPSec, VxLANs, HSRP, TCP/IP, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, QoS, Multicast, ACLs, VPNs, IP Tel, VoIP, Structured Cabling etc. 
Experience in using network management tools for performance, tuning, troubleshooting and capacity planning (E.g. Cisco PRIME, Concord eHealth, EtherPeek, InterMapper, MRTG, Cacti etc.).
Personal Effectiveness: Leadership, Creative Thinking, Learning Agility, Flexible and shows initiative.
Able to work as part of a virtual global/regional team with cultural, language, and time zone differences.
Team management experience desirable. Able to deal with ambiguity and work independently with minimal supervision/guidance, solid vendor management and negotiation skills. With Project management, process management, problem-solving & presentation skills.
Preferred certification like CISSP, CCSP, CCIE Sec etc.
Bachelor degree or above in Computer Science or Information Security related major.
