Apple-200690939.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Platforms Engineering
Apple-200690939.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!

Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.

Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.

Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you will embed with the engineering teams who use our platforms, then build the software that solves their problems. This is a software engineering-first role that goes well beyond feature development: you will sit with a customer team to understand their applications and workflows, translate ambiguous requirements into a technical design, write the production code, integrate it with existing systems, and stay with it through deployment and operational readiness. We run what we build, so you will also share an on-call rotation for the services the team owns — which is the fastest way to learn where the platform still falls short.

The work spans Go backend services, React and TypeScript applications, REST and gRPC APIs, distributed systems, and automation that reaches into public cloud, private cloud, Kubernetes, virtual machines, and bare-metal environments. You will also build AI-assisted capabilities — LLM integrations, and agentic workflows — along with the evaluations and quality controls that make those capabilities measurable and trustworthy enough to run in production.

You will move comfortably from a technical discussion with an engineering customer to designing a solution, writing the code, and validating that it works reliably at scale. You will approach loosely defined problems with curiosity and sound judgement, and you will know when a recurring customer request should become a reusable platform capability rather than another one-off integration. You care about clean, maintainable code, thoughtful architecture, and operational reliability, and you are as motivated by simplifying an existing system as by building a new one.

In a team with daring goals and real autonomy, you will take utmost ownership of what you ship — and measure your success by the engineering problems you solve and the lasting improvements you leave behind in the platforms other teams build on.

Work directly with internal engineering teams to understand their applications, infrastructure, and workflows, and translate what you learn into scalable, maintainable software
Design, build, and ship production software across Go backend services and React and TypeScript applications, owning it from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration
Architect and develop APIs, distributed services, integration frameworks, and automation that connect applications, infrastructure, and enterprise systems
Build and extend REST and gRPC APIs, including data modelling, authentication, authorization, and API contracts
Design for hybrid environments spanning public cloud, private cloud, Kubernetes, virtual machines, and bare-metal infrastructure, balancing scalability, security, availability, and operational complexity
Develop AI-assisted capabilities using LLM APIs, tool calling, and agentic workflows to automate engineering, infrastructure, and operational tasks
Establish evaluations, automated tests, and quality controls that make AI-driven features measurable and production-ready
Improve deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines, and application lifecycle workflows that simplify software delivery
Engineer reliability into what you build through observability, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and resilient design
Investigate complex issues across application, infrastructure, networking, and distributed system boundaries, and implement sustainable fixes rather than workarounds
Participate in the on-call rotation for services the team owns, contributing to incident response and production reliability
Turn recurring customer challenges into reusable features, shared services, and standardized integrations
Collaborate with multi-functional software, infrastructure, security, networking, and operations teams
Produce clear technical documentation and architectural guidance, and share engineering knowledge across teams
Apple-200690939.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing and delivering production software
Strong backend development skills in Go, or in a comparable language such as Rust, C++, or Python with the ability to become productive in Go
Solid understanding of software architecture, REST and gRPC APIs, distributed applications, and relational data modelling
Hands-on experience with relational and distributed SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Aurora, or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, query performance, and connection management
Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, TLS, and DNS record types, together with practical load balancing experience across L4 and L7, health checks, session affinity, and DNS-based global traffic management such as Route 53 or an equivalent
Experience with a major cloud provider such as AWS, GCP or AliCloud, across compute, storage, networking, load balancing, and identity and access management
Working knowledge of Linux, including systemd, processes, filesystems, permissions, and command-line troubleshooting
Understanding of service-to-service authentication and transport security, including mTLS, PKI and certificate lifecycle, OIDC, and RBAC
Familiarity with software delivery practices including source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments
Experience operating services in production, including observability with metrics, logs and traces, incident response, and root-cause analysis
Demonstrated technical leadership on multi-team projects — driving alignment, influencing partner teams, and raising the engineering bar around you
Ability to work from loosely defined requirements, evaluate implementation options, and choose a practical path forward
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with engineering customers

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
Experience building modern front-end applications with React and TypeScript, including component-based UI development and API integration
Experience building internal platforms, infrastructure automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software integrations
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and deployment tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Terraform, or Ansible
Experience building or operating distributed systems, including control planes, job orchestration, work queues, or state reconciliation
Depth in multi-region data consistency — locality-aware schema design, follower reads, or partitioning in CockroachDB, Spanner, or equivalent
Experience across hybrid and multi-region infrastructure, including private cloud, virtual machines, and bare-metal systems
Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk
Experience with network virtualization, software-defined networking, or data center network architecture
Experience with progressive delivery practices such as canary releases, blue/green deployments, and automated rollback
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs — prompt development, tool and function calling, multi-step workflows — and developing AI evaluations, agentic workflows, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
Demonstrated ability to turn customer-specific requirements into reusable software and platform capabilities
Experience mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, or setting technical direction for a team
Exposure to infrastructure or fleet management at scale

Apple-200685355.title: Full Stack Developer, Enterprise Systems
Apple-200685355.description:
Imagine what you can do here at Apple! Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their lives' best work. We believe hard work, creativity, and innovation fuel the ultimate customer experience. Each customer engagement is an opportunity to delight, engage, and inspire – and by focusing on the smallest of details, we can make big impacts on our customers. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with a solid background in building applications and services across both front-end and back-end, using Java/J2EE & Spring frameworks alongside modern client-side technologies, and who is comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate and improve the quality of software delivery. Work in an enterprise environment building innovative, end-to-end client-facing web applications — from database and services layer through to the UI. In this Software Engineer position, work on a team of software engineers building innovative, fast, and interactive applications incorporating the best technologies available, including AI/ML-powered capabilities. You'll work closely with our business collaborators and other partners to implement new solutions. In this role, work with other dedicated engineering minds across the company on some of the coolest technologies. Bring a passion for quality, a keen eye for detail, and curiosity for how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them, and you will be an outstanding fit. We need a motivated, critical problem solver with a sharp eye for detail, who can instrument, analyze, and identify bottlenecks in current processes — and use modern tooling, including AI, to come up with innovative solutions to address these. Come join us to do the best work of your life with a dedicated group of people. Bring your passion and dedication to the job and there's no telling what you could accomplish! 

As a successful teammate, help build innovative, full stack software applications spanning front-end UI, back-end services, and data layers. As a full stack software engineer, be a member of the team that implements new applications end-to-end, improves existing application features across the stack, while adding performance and software quality metrics to our codebase. Design and develop enterprise-level, highly available web application platforms applying Java, Spring frameworks, JPA & Hibernate, REST/SOAP web services on the back end, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React/Vue/Angular) on the front end. Develop prototypes and POCs to demonstrate new ideas or illustrate the use of new technologies — including generative AI and AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Apple internal AI coding assistants or similar LLM-based tools) — and how to apply them into our systems to improve developer productivity and code quality. Actively use AI-powered tools throughout the SDLC — for code generation, code review, test-case generation, debugging, documentation, and refactoring — to increase engineering efficiency and reduce time-to-delivery. Where applicable, integrate AI/ML-driven features (e.g., intelligent automation, recommendation logic, natural language interfaces) into enterprise applications to deliver smarter end-user experiences. Work with project managers, architects, technical leads, and vendors on defining the scope, achievement, deliverables, and resources needed for the project. Able to build a positive relationship with multi-functional internal organizations. Thrive in a multi-functional team on high-profile, critical projects. This position requires a self-motivated individual with strong technical understanding, problem-solving, and communication skills, and an eagerness to adopt AI-driven tools and practices to work smarter. Effective presentation, oral, and written business communication skills with various audiences and levels. Able to empower with passion, mentor, and lead geographically distributed teams. Maintain focus and prioritize a challenging workload while achieving extraordinary quality.
Apple-200685355.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Experience in architecting and developing event-based, distributed, highly available systems. 
Experience and knowledge in developing and handling enterprise-level technology at a global scale. 
Full stack development experience, comfortable working across both front-end (UI/UX implementation) and back-end (services, APIs, data) layers. 
Knowledge of securing applications, with a deep understanding of OWASP top 10 risks and solutions. 
Experience with Microservices, CI/CD, and container orchestration. 
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM-based code assistants, debugging/refactoring tools) to improve development speed and code quality. 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
5+ years of proven experience in architecting and developing event-based, distributed, highly available systems. 
5+ years of proven experience and knowledge in developing and handling enterprise-level technology at a global scale. 
Hands-on with one or more cloud platforms and managed services. 
Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
Experience working with client-facing web apps, as a full stack developer owning both UI and services layers. 
Solid knowledge of web application development using client-side frameworks/libraries like ReactJS/VueJS, jQuery, Bootstrap. Hands-on experience developing SPAs (Single Page Applications). 
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, distributed cache, and a clear understanding of standard methodologies & problem areas while handling large distributed datasets. 
Experience in building e-commerce applications. 
Practical experience applying AI/ML in software development — e.g., using generative AI for code generation/review, prompt engineering, building or integrating with LLM-based services/APIs, or embedding intelligent automation into enterprise applications. 
Exceptional software engineering background with an outstanding body of work demonstrating experience in software development, solution architecture, and product management. 
Understanding of Microservice Architecture, SAP Cloud Foundry features & capabilities. 
Thorough understanding of Software Development Lifecycle, tools, and standard methodologies — including how AI-assisted tooling fits into modern SDLC practices. 
Solid understanding of source control software (SVN or Git), experience with build and deployment tools (e.g., Maven, Gradle), and experience with automated testing methodologies and frameworks. 
Sharp problem-solving skills and real-world systems deployment experience. Consistent track record with rapid development cycles and demanding schedules. 
We seek a self-starter, forward-thinking person with strong leadership capabilities and genuine curiosity about applying AI to drive engineering efficiency. 
Excellent interpersonal skills and attention to detail for documenting and reviewing designs. 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience is preferred.

Apple-200679391.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Apple-200694071.title: Greater China Anodizing Color Engineer
Apple-200694071.description:
Here at Apple, the development and integration of revolutionary materials into our products are essential to the mechanical and electrical integrity, aesthetics, and overall feel our customers have come to expect. Our Materials Engineering Product Design team is dedicated to creating and optimizing these materials, enabling innovative designs across all product lines.

As an Anodizing Color Engineer, you will drive the development of new anodizing colors and dye processes to meet strict aesthetic and reliability requirements. Serving as a technical expert in Greater China, you will accelerate development cycles, partner deeply with suppliers, and help guide projects from R&D to mass production. We are looking for a hands-on, highly practical engineer with a system-level view of the anodizing process, who can make a direct impact on products.

Collaborate with cross functional teams to formulate, test, and qualify new recipes for industry-leading color and durability.
Translate visual design requirements into measurable specifications
Drive technical discussions and execute qualification trials for new processes
Support color realization together with broader teams
Develop and utilize simulation and modeling tools to guide development effort
Lead failure and root cause analysis and work closely with the broader global team to define strategic efforts.
Apple-200694071.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree or above in Materials Science, Chemistry, Electrochemistry, Surface Science, Color Science, or a related field, with relevant experience in anodizing or surface finishing of aluminum, or in colorants and color chemistry.
Experience with color measurement (spectrophotometry, CIELAB) and with visually evaluating high-quality cosmetic parts.
Solid color recognition skills, with the ability to accurately differentiate subtle color variations.
Proficiency in statistical analysis, design of experiments, and root cause analysis for color and finish issues.
Fluent in Mandarin and English, with excellent cross-functional communication skills.
Ability to work effectively across global time zones and travel (domestically in China and internationally to the US).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with color modeling or simulation, data analysis, or automated and high-throughput experimentation.
Technical knowledge of dyes, pigments, and dye-aluminum oxide interactions, with a strong foundation in color science.
Hands-on experience with reliability testing and characterization (e.g., UV-Vis, SEM/EDS, FTIR, ICP).
Highly independent, detail-oriented, and solution-driven, with the ability to manage multiple projects and vendor relationships concurrently.
Familiarity with AI-assisted design and analysis workflows.

Apple-200685012.title: Hardware Test Engineer - iPhone
Apple-200685012.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

We are searching for self-driven, passionate test engineers who will be responsible for building and developing test systems for the next generation of iPhone, taking a lead role in the debugging of HW/SW issues. The candidate will play a meaningful role in the development of Apple products, collaborate with Apple internal cross-functional teams and contract manufacturers, taking a lead role in design, test and manufacturing with a very high bar of quality.

As an iPhone Hardware Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the electrical and functional testing for iPhone main logic boards and form factors. Your role will involve designing and defining specifications for test hardware and software.
Apple's custom test solutions are sophisticated embedded systems that optimize for space efficiency, energy consumption, reliability, scalability, and cost. These systems integrate the latest embedded SOCs, custom analog and digital instruments, power systems, mechatronics, and real-time operating systems.
This position uniquely requires hardware and software expertise. For every new feature added to the iPhone, you will develop and implement new tests in collaboration with our third-party test vendor partners, system engineers, and factory teams. Your creativity in finding better ways to accomplish tasks is highly valued. You will work closely with the iPhone Hardware Engineering team to influence design for testability and develop innovative testing methods with minimal test access. You will be challenged to achieve more with fewer resources.

Participate in the design, test and development of the next generation iPhone from concept to mass production
Develop main logic board and system-level HW tests for connectivity, functionality, calibration etc.
Perform result review, data analysis, post-processing, and related tools development
Apple-200685012.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
B.S. (or M.S.) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent industry experience
Understand basic HW designs including schematics, data sheet, inter-comm protocols
Good coding skills in C/C++, Python, Shell, etc.
Excellent communication skills in both English and Chinese
Understand best practices for HW test setup, measurement and execution

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong fundamentals in electrical engineering, experienced in designing embedded microcontroller systems, analog instrumentation, DC power supplies etc.
Proficiency in data post-processing and visualization
Direct experience in high-volume computers, mobile devices, or consumer electronics
A naturally curious mind paired with both intuitive and rigorous problem-solving skills
Knowledge of algorithms, machine learning, or artificial intelligence (AI) is a strong plus
Experience with OS services, specifically in kernel or driver development and debugging; familiarity with BSD/Mach-like kernels is a plus
3-5 years of relevant working experience

Apple-200685608.title: Head of Infrastructure SRE in China
Apple-200685608.description:
People at Apple don't just build products, they craft the kind of experience that has revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that power Apple's services (such as iCloud, Apple Music, Apple Intelligence, and Maps). We are the foundation on which Apple's software developers build the products that our customers love. Our services have to scale globally, stay highly available, and "just work." If you love designing, engineering, and running systems and infrastructure that will help millions of customers, then this is the place for you!

As the Head of Site Reliability Engineering for ASE Virtual Infrastructure and Service Delivery (VISD) in China, you will lead and inspire a world-class team of software engineers to build and deliver solutions which underpin very large scale services at Apple. You will be a key member of the VISD leadership team, responsible for setting and executing the strategic vision for ASE VISD across all of Apple Services Engineering in China.

Define and execute the multi-year strategic vision for the reliability, availability, and performance of Apple's mission-critical cloud platform services.
Lead, scale, and inspire a local organization of Site Reliability Engineering managers and engineers focused on massive-scale Kubernetes, compute infrastructure, data platform, and traffic.
Partner at the executive level with software engineering, architecture, and product teams to align on architectural direction, business priorities, system design for operability, and local deployment.
Drive organizational excellence by establishing and scaling robust SRE frameworks, including SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and incident management at an enterprise level.
Oversee massive-scale infrastructure budgets, hardware capacity planning, and strategic vendor or cloud provider relationships.
Apple-200685608.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, an engineering-related field, or equivalent related experience.
15+ years of engineering experience in a leadership role managing a large team within infrastructure, cloud, or SRE domains.
Proven track record of operating and scaling massive, globally distributed, multi-tenant Kubernetes and bare-metal environments in production.
Expertise in organizational design, scaling engineering teams, and mentoring senior engineering leaders.
Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise-wide, cross-functional initiatives and influence executive stakeholders.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin, with the ability to distill complex technical concepts for diverse leadership audiences.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Deep understanding of modern cloud-native architectures, AI/ML infrastructure scaling (e.g., GPU orchestration), Data Platform (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink) and hybrid-cloud strategies.
Strong financial acumen for managing large-scale infrastructure OPEX and CAPEX budgets.
Track record of working with globally distributed engineering organizations across multiple time zones.
Experience running infrastructure as an internal managed service with defined, enterprise-grade SLAs.
Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Computer Science or a related field.
Knowledge of the China technology ecosystem and regulatory landscape, with proven experience interfacing with local authorities, is a strong plus.

Identify opportunities to improve technical operations and up skill partner teams by demonstrating best practices, while fostering deep collaboration with software developers across the Data Platform Services to deliver seamless customer experiences

Apple-200690651.title: Mac Product Design Engineer
Apple-200690651.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with Apple products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple Mac products. 
Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unrivaled and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming Mac products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple customers every single day.

As a Product Design Intern, you will help create the next generation of hardware devices. You will gain hands-on experience bringing the design from concept to reality.
Hands-On Design: 3D and 2D mechanical design of components, mechanisms, and electro-mechanical integrations (battery, antenna, PCB, interconnections).
Prototyping & Testing: Help generate concepts, build prototypes, and perform rigorous mechanical, tolerance, and failure analysis to evaluate the design.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Hardware, Program Management, Industrial Design, Operations, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to ensure designs meet aesthetic and functional goals.

Support design, engineering, prototyping, and validation activities in both laboratory and factory environments.
Create 3D models and 2D drawings, and perform tolerance analysis to ensure precise fit and assembly.
Conduct engineering data collection and leverage statistical or AI-driven tools to analyze results and inform design decisions.
Optimize component designs for high-volume manufacturing, applying DFM/DFA principles for injection molding, sheet metal, and CNC machining.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support factory builds and perform root-cause/failure analysis (may include up to 20% travel).
Communicate technical specifications, test results, and design updates clearly and effectively to internal teams and external vendors.
Apple-200690651.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Product Design, or a related field of study.
Proficiency in verbal and written communication in both English and Chinese
Proficiency in 3D CAD software (Siemens NX preferred).
Hands-on prototyping experience utilizing 3D printers, CNC mills, lathes, and/or other fabrication methods.
Knowledge of materials science fundamentals, spanning plastics, metals, adhesives, glass, ceramics, composites, and coatings.
Familiarity with manufacturing and tolerancing, including DFM, DFA, statistical tolerance analysis, and GD&T.
Understanding of engineering analysis, including Finite Element Analysis (FEA) theory, general mechanical principles, and statistical tools.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Familiarity with electro-mechanical integration, specifically packaging components like batteries and wireless antennas into mechanical enclosures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, fueled by a genuine curiosity for how things work.
Highly proactive and adaptable, with the initiative to drive tasks forward and the flexibility to pivot when needed.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tests and project requests simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication, paired with the ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-based environment.

Apple-200678375.title: Mac System Engineering Program Manager
Apple-200678375.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

As a System Engineering Program Manager for Mac, you will be responsible for managing engineering development for our future generations of Mac. You will use your program management skills, imagination, and creativity to lead a cross-functional team of skilled engineers and push these exciting programs forward!

This individual contributor role will have significant responsibilities in making decisions, collaborating with cross-functional teams, vendors and suppliers around the globe during the entire product development cycle. This includes planning and executing build events from readiness to on time delivery, assessing and communicating cross-functional risks and issues, driving cross-functional teams to resolve critical build blockers, and serving as the primary point of contact for US EPMs and CM partners to align on build objectives.

Partner with and guide CM engineering teams to deliver robust project execution.
Lead cross-functional communications between Apple Internal project teams and external vendors.
Plan and execute build events, including material planning, factory readiness, managing and executing complex DOE requests from engineering team and ensuring on-time delivery.
Work with internal teams and external vendors to define build plans, track progress, and escalate issues as appropriate.
Enable development efforts by creating and monitoring an efficient, streamlined process between Apple teams and external vendors.
Provide timely issue resolution and critical path/risk assessment management.
Facilitate clear communication and provide multi-level status updates to stakeholders ranging from individual contributors to executive management.
Drive day-to-day engineering build activities at vendor factories to meet overall program objectives.
Apple-200678375.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of project management experience.
Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Process Manufacturing background is preferred.
Fluent in both written and spoken English and Mandarin.
Strong leadership skills and the ability to inspire cross-functional team members.
Impeccable organizational, multitasking, and detail-oriented program management skills.
Flexibility and willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Relevant NPI or engineering development experience, especially with Apple, is a plus.
Self-motivated and proactive individual with demonstrated creativity and critical-thinking capabilities.
Able to collaborate with cross-functional team to achieve project goals.
Excellent consolidation, communication and organizational skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment to meet tight schedules.
Ability to leverage AI tools to streamline engineering documentation (such as reports, issue logs, and executive summaries) while supporting proactive scenario planning and contingency assessments.

Apple-200677278.title: Manager, TechOps / Site Reliability Engineering
Apple-200677278.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  

Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.

At Apple, we are dedicated to creating innovative solutions that delight our users through ultra-fast, thoughtfully engineered, and meticulously crafted products. Our team is not just any group — we are a highly motivated, dynamic, and ever evolving collection of individuals driven by a passion for excellence and continuous improvement.

The Customer Systems Operations team is seeking an exceptional Manager to lead a team of TechOps and Site Reliability Engineers responsible for the availability, performance, and resilience of Apple's business-critical operational platforms. The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility in infrastructure and reliability engineering, strong people leadership, and a proven ability to keep globally distributed, 24x7 operational teams delivering in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment.

You will operate at the intersection of engineering, operational excellence, and AI innovation — partnering closely with global engineering managers and business stakeholders to guide technical direction, modernize operational practices, and accelerate reliability outcomes through GenAI-enabled engineering and automation. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both organizational leadership and direct technical ownership of the team's day-to-day delivery.

Lead and develop a team of TechOps and SRE engineers, owning end-to-end delivery accountability for their operational work, incident response, and reliability initiatives.

Provide direct technical guidance on infrastructure design, automation strategy, and incident response, staying closely engaged with the team's day-to-day work.

Define and drive the team's technical and operational roadmap, aligned to enterprise reliability and delivery strategy.

Establish governance models, engineering standards, and execution frameworks for operational work across the team.

Lead the team's response to major incidents, including post-incident reviews and long-term reliability improvements.

Champion adoption of GenAI-driven engineering and operational practices to improve automation, productivity, and delivery outcomes.

Drive data-driven decision making and AI-enabled operational excellence, including SLO/error-budget tracking and KPI reporting.

Manage staffing, workload balancing, and 24x7 on-call/shift coverage plans across a globally distributed team.

Hire, coach, and mentor TechOps/SRE engineers while building a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Act as the primary technical liaison and interface between the team and global engineering managers, operations managers, business partners, and cross-functional leaders across regions.

Partner with application engineering, product, and business operations leaders to align priorities and execution.

Provide clear communication to global managers and leadership on team/program health, risks, and outcomes.
Apple-200677278.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
15+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, TechOps, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering, with hands-on background designing and operating highly available, scalable, and secure systems (cloud and on-prem infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, observability/monitoring platforms).
8+ years directly managing a team of TechOps/SRE/DevOps engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
Experience managing globally distributed teams across time zones, including 24x7 coverage and on-call/shift models.
Working knowledge of incident management practices, SLO/error-budget frameworks, and operational excellence disciplines.
Familiarity with applying GenAI capabilities to engineering/operational workflows.
Ability to operate effectively with senior/global managers and stakeholders while maintaining deep technical engagement with the team's day-to-day work.
Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Demonstrated ability to build, inspire, and retain high-performing technical operations organizations.
Experience in Contact Center, Retail, or other high-availability customer-facing platforms and technologies.

Apple-200675719.title: Manufacturing Design & Manufacturing Quality Engineer
Apple-200675719.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The people here don’t just build products — they craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 
Join the Manufacturing Design (MDE) and Quality Engineering (MQE) teams, and help enable the mass creation of impossible products as a partner in the development of Apple's renowned designs.

In this highly visible new graduate role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Apple products and leave a footprint for years to come. You will apply your engineering background to evaluate product designs, develop cutting-edge manufacturing methods, and implement rigorous quality controls. 
Whether your academic or project background lies in mechanical fabrication, materials science, automation, or data-driven analysis, you will bridge foundational engineering principles with high-volume manufacturing to achieve ambitious specifications at a massive scale. Both MDE and MQE tracks will require close collaboration with Asia-based manufacturing partners to support on-site prototype builds, equipment testing, and factory ramp-ups.

For Manufacturing Design Engineer (MDE):

Design and optimize mass-production manufacturing processes—such as CNC, laser, 3D printing, complex assembly, or chemical surface treatments.
Develop and validate mechanical fixtures, assembly mechanisms, and automation layouts based on intricate product drawings.
Execute Design of Experiments (DOEs) to identify optimal processing parameters, evaluate prototype technologies, and ensure machine stability.
Partner cross-functionally with Product Design Engineering to assess the manufacturability of new features and recommend capable production equipment.

For Manufacturing Quality Engineer (MQE):

Develop and implement advanced quality inspection tools and measurement technologies to evaluate cosmetic, material, and dimensional part characteristics.
Compile and analyze manufacturing data, leveraging data science or statistical principles to determine appropriate limits and process specifications.
Lead Failure Analysis (FA) and root cause investigations to resolve process yield issues and drive continuous quality improvements.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams to evaluate product designs and manufacturing methods to ensure ambitious specifications are achieved at massive production scale.
Apple-200675719.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Academic lab, or internship involvement focusing on at least one of the following domains: CNC, laser processing, 3D printing, automation, assembly, materials, surface treatments, Failure Analysis (FA), or data science.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Solid grasp of engineering fundamentals, 2D/3D design, measurement technologies, and core manufacturing processes.
Track record of conducting root cause analysis or evaluating data using statistical analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab) for process optimization.
Foundational programming skills (e.g., Python, MATLAB) with exposure to automation control methodologies, computer vision, or machine learning.
High self-motivation combined with a highly detail-oriented and results-driven approach to solving hands-on engineering problems.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to multi-functional teams.

Apple-200690946.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, wonderful ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

At Apple, we don’t just build products — we create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of our people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts.

We invite you to join us on this venture and help us leave the world better than we found it!

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity, and thus we treat all applicants fairly and equally. Apple is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

As a MQA Intern focusing on data analysis and optimization, you will work closely with the team to understand data-driven challenges and analysis needs. Our primary focus is developing applications such as algorithms research, workflow optimization, predictive analytics, and other data-driven tools that empower the MQA team to streamline workflows, enhance efficiency, and reduce costs. Your contributions will directly impact the success of our projects, and your innovative thinking will help shape the future of AI in the manufacturing industry.

You will be directly responsible for building innovative solutions to transform the manufacturing industry, focusing on process automation and intelligent decision-making, leveraging your expertise in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Machine Learning (ML).

Design and develop automated workflows using RPA tools, particularly with Python and Selenium, to streamline data collection and operational processes within the supply chain.

Stay current with the latest advancements in RPA, machine learning, and automation technologies, prototyping and proposing innovative solutions to complex manufacturing challenges.

Develop and deploy machine learning models using libraries like Scikit-learn to enhance predictive capabilities, such as root cause analysis & anomaly detection.

Leverage AutoML frameworks to accelerate model development, selection, and tuning, ensuring rapid deployment of high-performing ML solutions.
Apple-200690946.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Foundational knowledge in mathematics and statistics is required.

Working knowledge of Python and experience in data analysis, anomaly detection, and commonality analysis.

Strong understanding of robotic process automation (RPA) & machine learning (ML) methodologies.

Familiarity with ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch for developing and deploying models.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying RPA solutions, specifically using Python libraries such as Selenium for web automation and data extraction.

Proficiency in the Python data science ecosystem, with strong hands-on experience in Scikit-learn for model building and familiarity with AutoML tools or platforms.

Understanding of the manufacturing industry and its challenges is a plus.

Experience with cloud-based computing platforms like AWS/GCP/Ali-Cloud is a plus.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on real-world applications.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively in a team environment.

Apple-200662470.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new insights have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  We are strengthening the team, and we are seeking a dynamic Mechanical Quality Engineer. We feature a collaborative environment with creative, smart people and groundbreaking technologies. Join us and make a difference!
In this highly visible role, you will have the chance to create a significant impact on Apple Products, and leave a footprint for years to come. We have an opportunity for an accomplished quality engineer to lead development, and ramp for a next generation Apple product.  

Our quality engineering team enables the mass creation of impossible products as a partner in the development of Apple's renowned designs.    
Key Responsibilities will include:
You will partner with multi-functional teams to evaluate design and processes at the concept phase  
Develop measurement technologies, control strategies, information systems, and manufacturing methods that achieve adventurous specifications at mass production scale   - You will develop and implement groundbreaking quality inspection tools to evaluate cosmetic and dimensional part characteristics  
Compile and evaluate data to determine appropriate limits and variables for process and part specifications  
Lead activities to balance unparalleled quality with scalable yields 
You will collaborate with internal and external groups to ensure that proper definition of quality expectations and that appropriate assurance techniques are used for the product   
Coordinate all Quality Engineering functions for a program, serving as project manager to lead efforts at supplier locations  
Establish audit procedures appropriate to program and supplier to ensure consistency to Apple quality standards  
Evaluate and communicate yields of new and existing processes  
Drive corrective actions multi-functionally with internal and external team members

Experience developing process quality plans, supplier quality audits, and driving corrective actions and failure analysis efforts

Working knowledge of mechanical quality and reliability concepts, supplier management, and general manufacturing operations
Experience with the development and evaluation of measurement systems
Project management experience and a deep understanding of problem solving tools including design of experiments, root cause analysis and statistical analytical tools
Experience with any of the following: mechanical enclosures, castings, plastic parts, injection molding, tooling, jigs, fixtures, or automotive high volume quality manufacturing engineering
Exceptional ability to establish relationships; data-driven and willing to take action; enthusiastic and motivated; and detailed while managing several work streams.
Knowledge on Data Science, including Statistics, Machine Learning, Regression are preferred

Apple-200688123.title: Measurement Strategist (Data Analyst) - Apple Ads, Greater China
Apple-200688123.description:
At Apple, we work every day to build products that enrich people’s lives. Our Apple Ads group makes it possible for people around the world to easily access informative and imaginative content on their devices while helping publishers and developers promote and monetize their work. Today, our technology and services power advertising in Apple News, the App Store, and on Apple TV+. 

The Apple Ads team is seeking a Measurement Strategist - someone with the analytical skills to identify, develop, and package unique insights for our advertisers. You will have the ability to convert these insights into a compelling narrative combined with the communication skills to co-deliver these insights direct to advertisers to advise, persuade, and ultimately change advertiser behavior.

The Measurement Strategist joins the team responsible for evaluating, sourcing, refining and presenting unique insights to help our advertising customers get the most value out of their investment in Apple Ads. 
In this role, you will:
* Support Apple Ads Sales team from both business and technical lens to drive revenue growth.
* Deep-dive in client challenges, identify and conduct analysis to respond and solve complex customer problems.
* Work with large data sets, breaking it down into easily understandable stories, and communicate these narratives to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Data Insights team to identify the right metrics, measure and track the impact of client interactions and revenue outcome; contribute ideas and provide feedback for new insights development.
* Liaise with Privacy and Legal teams to ensure that proposed data sets honor Apple Ads’ privacy principles.
* Collaborate with Product team to integrate successful pilots into customer facing reporting tools.

5 or more years of experience in the digital advertising industry, in a data analyst or business/performance measurement role
Advanced skills in SQL queries, Tableau and conducting analysis based on large data sets 
Solid experience in face-to-face and visual client interactions - specifically with senior level executives, business intelligence and data science experts
Strong communication skills and the ability to distill information from big data and results into simple concepts and actionable insights for a variety of audiences
Excellent communication, project management, and organizational skills to work closely with Partner Development and various functional teams - to understand business requirements, and handle sophisticated projects related to data-driven initiatives
Strong personal code of ethics, integrity, diversity, and trust
Native level fluency in Mandarin and business level fluency in English are mandatory to cover key clients in Asia

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Familiarity with search engine marketing (SEM), app-install marketing and attribution
Advanced technical skills: experiences with Python and Salesforce
Business level fluency in Korean or Japanese is a plus
BA/BS in Analytics, Engineering, Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields

Apple-200690363.title: Module Manufacturing Quality Engineer
Apple-200690363.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, innovative ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. This is where individual imaginations and experiences gather together to lead to great work. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!

In this highly visible, hands-on role, you will support Operations and Engineering in developing and sustaining some of the highest quality products in the world. You will own the quality systems framework at Asia-based suppliers across the full product lifecycle, from early development through mass production and end of life. You will build, audit, and continuously improve supplier quality management systems so that process control, change management, traceability, and corrective action are robust and sustainable. You will also lead on-site problem-solving, metrology review and development, and improvements in supplier yield, process capability, and product field performance.

Quality Systems Development
Define, implement, and maintain supplier quality system requirements, ensuring that suppliers have documented, effective, and consistently followed procedures for process control, inspection, handling nonconformance, and continuous improvement.

Assess supplier quality management systems against Apple requirements and industry standards, identify gaps, and drive structured improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines.

Establish and enforce robust change management, including engineering change control, process change notification, and requalification, to prevent unintended quality impact.

Ensure end-to-end traceability of materials, processes, equipment, and test data, from sub-tier materials through final shipment, to support rapid containment and root cause investigation.

Verify supplier document and record control, calibration and gauge management, operator training and certification, and equipment maintenance systems.

New Product Introduction (NPI)
Support cross-functional stage-gate reviews in each phase of new product introduction. This includes key sub-tier supplier capability, process and line readiness, quality control plans, reliability test plans, gauge R&R, and correlations to ensure end-to-end quality coverage.

Review and approve supplier FMEAs, control plans, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics to confirm that risks are identified and mitigated before ramp.
Lead metrology review and development, including measurement system analysis, gauge R&R, fixture and inspection solution design, and cross-site correlation.

Supplier Management and Audit
Manage supplier resources and run routine system, process, and product audits to detect issues early and ensure the highest levels of quality and reliability are delivered consistently.
Track audit findings through closure, verify the effectiveness of corrective actions, and escalate recurring or systemic issues appropriately.

Process Control and Continuous Improvement
Establish and implement quality plans to ensure proper standards are in place, including incoming, in-process, final inspection, and outgoing quality controls. Drive suppliers to meet ramp targets through yield, UPH, and efficiency improvements.

Monitor mass production (MP) yield and process capability trends, perform gap analysis, and work with suppliers to propose and implement improvement actions.
Apply SPC and statistical tools to detect process shifts early and to define effective control limits and reaction plans.

Lead failure analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) efforts for in-line, outgoing, and field returns, and confirm that root causes are fully addressed and sustained.

Analyze field performance data and feed learnings back into design, process, and quality plan improvements.

Supplier Capability Development
Direct and guide supplier quality engineers, develop supplier capability (including necessary training), and establish proper reporting of final inspection and test results to Apple. Share best practices across the supply base and drive standardization of quality methods and tools.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work with other Apple functional groups (Engineering, Operations, Reliability, Program Management, and Supply Chain) as resources to optimize supplier quality programs.
Communicate quality status, risks, and mitigation plans clearly to stakeholders at all levels, in both English and Mandarin.
Apple-200690363.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Minimum 3+ years of quality management experience in manufacturing, with hands-on exposure to quality management systems

Working knowledge of quality system standards and methodologies, such as ISO 9001 or equivalent, and FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, and SPC

Experience developing process quality plans, supplier quality deliverables, and inspection solutions, and driving corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and failure analysis (8D, 5-Why, fishbone)

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong statistical data analysis skills and solid statistics concepts, including Design of Experiments (DOE), capability analysis (Cp/Cpk, Pp/Ppk), and JMP/Minitab

Experience conducting supplier audits (system, process, and product), including audit planning, execution, reporting, and closure tracking

Soft skills including leadership, project management, communication, teamwork, influencing, and negotiation

Constant interfacing with multiple functional teams (Engineering, Operations, etc) within Apple, as well as with various suppliers and sub-tier suppliers

Willingness to travel frequently to supplier sites across China

Experience with AI/ML applications or smart manufacturing tools is a plus.

Apple-200666736.title: Network Engineer
Apple-200666736.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together we create products and experiences people once couldn’t have envisioned — and now can’t imagine living without. If you’re excited by the idea of making an impact, joining a team where we pride ourselves in being one of the most diverse and expansive companies in the world, a career with Apple might be your dream job. 

Global Network Services keeps Apple’s world-class DataCenter network running smoothly and efficiently. We are a global team of engineers who operate the diverse technology, protocol and vendor stack that interconnects all facets of Apple’s network at a scale that is second to none. We are looking for an enthusiastic and passionate person to join a dynamic and exciting team within Apple’s Global Network Services. You will be skilled in cross-organizational collaboration, liaising with internal teams and external service providers to operate and maintain the network infrastructure. You will need to develop and maintain clear documentation and procedures associated with operations and known issues. This position provides the opportunity to operate a cutting-edge, worldwide, multi-vendor network.

In this fast paced role, you will provide front line support for Apple’s Data Center network to address a wide variety of business challenges. You will be comfortable in a dynamic environment with the ability to multi-task and provide operational support to various businesses within Apple. 

This position requires a collaborative teammate who will enjoy working with others around the globe. Your responsibilities will include working on tickets and break fixes, maintaining and upgrading existing networks to current standards, and sustaining operations, as well as contributing to technical and procedural documentation. In this role you will obsess over minute details and drive operational excellence in every aspect of your work to deliver the best possible customer experience. In addition to the required technical networking skills, this position will also draw on strong interpersonal skills and an individual who enjoys the dynamic nature of Apple’s environment. If you enjoy close collaboration, open and active discussion, and following through on the details, we think you’ll love being part of our team.

3-5 years of experience in network troubleshooting
Extraordinary interpersonal communications and customer-service skills
Experience evaluating and managing outages to business critical infrastructure
Ability to maintain composure and customer-service focus in stressful and ambiguous situations
Ability to coordinate and troubleshoot with internal and external partner teams
Strong understandi ng of IPv4 and IPv6
Upstanding of BGP and OSPF routing, L2 switching technologies and ACL management
Experience with Cisco, Arista, Juniper or other vendors

Experience working in large scale environments and with ITIL incident and problem management

Apple-200688121.title: Noise & Vibration Engineer
Apple-200688121.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services and customer experiences. Sound is an essential and compelling facet of the customer experience - Apple has assembled a world-class Acoustics team that enables our customers to experience music with delight, communicate with clarity and appreciate our products without disturbance from noise. In Apple Acoustics we work with obsessive attention to detail, directly contributing to products that ship to millions of people around the world. 

Our Noise & Vibration team contributes to hardware design, validation, and troubleshooting to minimize distracting audible noises and optimize their sound quality. We are a diverse team of acoustics and vibration experts, accomplished listeners, and creative problem solvers. We work daily with multifunctional teams on innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. We are looking for a Noise & Vibration Engineer to join our team based in Shenzhen, China.

As part of Apple’s Noise & Vibration group, this Engineer will lead the noise and vibration activities in Shenzhen, China, with a wide range of responsibilities, including:

Implementing test methodologies, writing test scripts, and creating test plans and standard operating procedures for acoustic noise testing in factory environments
Analyzing data using noise level, noise spectrum, and sound quality metrics
Troubleshooting design or process issues that result in unwanted acoustic noise
Creating and implementing innovative test and noise issue resolution solutions
Working closely with Apple US & other Noise & Vibration teams, as well as local and headquarters cross-functional teams, across all noise and vibration activities
Coordinating with contract manufacturer teams in testing, failure analysis, data management, and work planning, to ensure smooth lab operation and timely delivery of high-quality test data and troubleshooting results
Setting up factory noise and vibration test labs and bringing up testers
Domestic travel several times per year with occasional international travel
Apple-200688121.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS in Mechanical Engineering, Acoustics, or related field with 5+ years of directly relevant experience, or MS with 3+ years (or equivalent practical experience/PhD).
Strong theoretical and experimental background in acoustics and/or vibration.
Solid noise and vibration testing and data analysis skills, and familiarity with typical noise and vibration testing equipment and analysis tools.
Acute acoustic listening ability with critical judgment across the audible frequency spectrum for subjective sound quality evaluation.
Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB, or equivalent languages for test automation, signal analysis, and data visualization or make this requirement weaker by using ‘Comfortable with Matlab, Python, or other scripting languages, and ability to learn new scripting skills’. 
Excellent English communication skills with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with vibration modal testing and analysis
Experience leveraging LLMs/AI-assisted tools for engineering workflows
Proven experience in multinational companies, working with cross-functional teams, and/or contract manufacturers and suppliers, is highly desirable
Ability to effectively contribute in a fast-paced, constantly changing, multitasking environment with shifting priorities.
Flexibility in problem-solving approaches

Apple-200685592.title: Observability SRE Manager, Apple Services Engineering
Apple-200685592.description:
People at Apple don't just build products, they craft the kind of experiences that have revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple's services (such as iCloud, iTunes, Siri, and Maps). We are the foundation on which Apple's software developers build the products that our customers love.

Apple's observability and monitoring platforms are the nervous system behind the reliability of Apple's cloud services, giving thousands of engineers the visibility they need to detect, diagnose, and resolve issues before they impact customers. Our cloud monitoring platform analyzes billions of metrics per minute and is the first place incident responders turn when something goes wrong, regardless of system scale or complexity.

We're looking for a senior SRE leader to own and evolve this platform: the metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting infrastructure that underpins operational excellence across Apple Services Engineering.

You'll set technical direction for reliability and operational excellence while mentoring engineers, driving automation, and partnering closely with software, infrastructure, finance, and product teams to uphold the reliability of the platform whilst shipping improvements that matter at Apple scale.

This is a senior leadership position that defines where our observability platform reliability, scalability and performance goes next, how our SRE practice evolves, including how AI reshapes it, and how we build the team and partnerships to get there. You will lead engineers solving reliability and scale problems few organizations encounter, integrating monitoring seamlessly across disparate infrastructures, hardware, software, application, and network layers, at a scale built to reach every user on the planet. You'll build a team culture that makes SRE sustainable, rewarding, and central to how Apple ships services.

The successful candidate has a strong aptitude for both technical leadership and people management, with the ability to context-switch between strategic planning and tactical execution. You should be comfortable building and scaling teams, driving complex cross-functional initiatives, and thriving under pressure, while creating an inclusive, high-trust team culture where engineers do their best work.

We believe AI will fundamentally reshape how SRE is practiced, from anomaly detection and root-cause analysis to capacity planning and toil elimination, and we're looking for a leader who shares that conviction and can drive that transformation across the organization.

Technical & Operational Leadership
Own the reliability, availability, and performance of Apple's observability platform (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) and the self-service capabilities built on top of it
Lead staging and production environments for the observability platform with the goal of maximizing availability
Ensure the platform accurately monitors the health of every application and piece of infrastructure across the Apple ecosystem, the "central nervous system" that other engineering teams and incident responders reach for first
Define and drive the strategic roadmap for observability infrastructure in partnership with SRE, engineering, and product stakeholders
Establish and refine SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, scale testing, disaster recovery, and change management
Guide deep dives into systemic and latent reliability issues spanning the full stack (hardware, software, application, and network), partnering with software and systems engineers to drive fixes to resolution
Drive incident response, post-incident reviews, and systemic improvements that reduce operational toil
Champion automation to eliminate manual processes through tooling, self-service platforms, and APIs for internal customers
Manage on-call rotations and ensure sustainable, well-supported operational coverage
Drive standardization of monitoring and troubleshooting methodology across embedded SREs and services throughout the organization
Represent the SRE organization in design reviews and operational readiness exercises for new and existing services
Partner with software engineering and architecture teams to influence system design for reliability, scalability, and operability
Balance technical debt reduction with feature development to maintain platform health

AI & Modernization
Define and execute a clear AI strategy for the SRE organization, identifying high-impact opportunities where AI/ML tooling can reduce toil, accelerate root-cause analysis, and improve reliability outcomes
Drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (copilots, intelligent runbooks, LLM-based diagnostics, anomaly detection) into day-to-day SRE workflows
Build a culture where engineers actively experiment with AI tools and modern approaches to solve operational problems

People Leadership & Org Building
Lead, grow, and mentor a team of Site Reliability Engineers, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development discussions
Hire and build out the SRE team, with a desire to develop engineers to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals
Build and scale a high-performing team through coaching, clear expectations, and psychological safety
Foster an inclusive team culture and mentor diverse talent
Champion engineering best practices for code quality, system design, and operational excellence across the broader organization

Cross-Functional & Executive Communication
Build strong partnerships across Apple, negotiating priorities and aligning on shared goals with an Apple-first mindset
Represent the SRE perspective in cross-functional planning, translating reliability requirements into architecture and investment decisions
Communicate effectively at the executive level, presenting strategy, trade-offs, and progress to senior leadership
Drive standardization and best practices across the observability and infrastructure landscape
Apple-200685592.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of engineering management experience leading SRE, infrastructure, or observability/monitoring teams
Experience hiring and leading engineers, with a desire to build, grow, and mentor a team
Deep understanding of observability systems and practices: metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, SLOs, error budgets, and fault analysis at scale
Strong systems background, comfortable troubleshooting across the full stack (network, OS, container runtime, application)
Experience operating large-scale, multi-tenant distributed systems in production, including Kubernetes environments
Practical, solid knowledge of shell/bash scripting and at least one higher-level production language (Python preferred; Go, Java, or Scala also valued)
Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML tooling or LLM-based solutions to improve SRE or infrastructure operations
Track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, clear expectations, and psychological safety
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives to completion and communicate at the executive level
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Deep familiarity with the Prometheus ecosystem and cloud-native observability stacks (Thanos, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, or similar)
Experience with third-party cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Comfortable with open-source configuration management and orchestration tools (Helm, Puppet, Spinnaker)
Demonstrable knowledge of TCP/IP, HTTP, web application security, and multi-tier web application architectures
Experience running infrastructure as an internal managed service with defined SLAs
Familiarity with microservices architecture and container orchestration with Kubernetes at scale
Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or infrastructure architecture
Track record of driving cultural and process transformation within SRE organizations
Experience building or deploying AI-powered operational tooling (AIOps, intelligent alerting, automated diagnostics)
Developing and delivering multi-mode communications tailored to the unique needs of different audiences
Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders
Making sense of complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively
Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations
Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement

Apple-200678940.title: Operations Engineer
Apple-200678940.description:
The Operations Engineer in Crypto Services team manages key technical infrastructure. An ideal candidate will have experience in Systems Administration. The Operations Engineer will monitor infrastructure and application services and drive incident management. The Ops engineer will work closely with SRE's, PKI Engineers, systems engineers, network engineers, database administrators and information security teams to effectively ensure availability and reliability. For this position, strict application security and high availability requirements must be balanced to achieve optimal solutions.

The successful candidate will participate in troubleshooting issues following established procedures, documenting problems, managing incidents and owning the issue from the initial contact to resolution. Additionally the engineer will be responsible for critical compliance tasks,  system patching and upgrades, and building out observability tooling to support the team's operations.

Serve as a full time, primary on-call, responding and mobilizing efforts to address outages 
Follow change management procedures and deploy code using configuration management (e.g. Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc) 
Perform routine and emergency patching and RHEL version upgrades across the fleet
Set priorities and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment 
Measure and optimize system performance 
Monitor telemetry and address alerts to ensure smooth operations 
Design, build, and maintain dashboards and create alerting rules to improve visibility into system health
Process and manage log pipelines to support troubleshooting, auditing, and compliance needs
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across multiple business and technical teams 
Demonstrate ability to deliver results on time with high quality
Apple-200678940.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of expertise with Linux (any distro, but especially RHEL),  including experience with OS patching and upgrade cycles. Standard UNIX utilities and programs
Strong understanding of SRE principles and goals, coupled with prior on-call experience, including leading incident command and management efforts.
Proficiency with configuration management tools (e.g., Puppet, Chef, Ansible) and scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python).
Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., Icinga/Nagios) and log aggregation platforms (e.g., Splunk, OpenSearch) , and building dashboards/alerts
A proven track record of practical problem-solving, coupled with excellent communication and documentation skills, particularly in conveying complex technical information to diverse audiences.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with distributed teams or managing operations across multiple time zones.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/AliCloud) and container technologies (Podman, Docker, Kubernetes).
A deep understanding of security and compliance best practices, especially within a cryptographic or PKI environment.
Experience supporting Java applications and/or managing critical hardware like Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
Flexibility to travel for work
