Apple-200665566.title: PLC Automation Engineer (Programmable Logic Controller)
Apple-200665566.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. Apple's Hardware Test Engineering (HWTE) group is looking for a passionate, highly collaborative PLC Automation Engineer. In this role, you will be at the heart of our automated test and calibration systems, architecting the control logic that ensures the flawless mass production of Apple's most innovative products. You will not only design complex machine logic but also own core automation frameworks, establish safety standards, and drive the integration of our equipment into Apple’s next-generation smart factory ecosystems.

As a PLC Automation Engineer in HWTE, you will own the software architecture, control logic, and integration of complex automated test fixtures. You will not be working in a silo: this role operates in a highly dynamic, cross-functional (XF) environment where you will partner daily with mechanical engineers, software engineers (macOS/iOS), test instrumentation specialists, and operations teams.
We need a technical leader who bridges the gap between traditional automation and modern software engineering.You will translate complex test requirements into robust, modular PLC code using Object- Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, while governing the automation standards used by our global vendors. If you have a deep passion for machine state modeling, excel at diagnosing electromechanical systems in the field, and want to lead the charge on "Future Factory" initiatives, we want to hear from you.

Core Architecture & Governance: Own the HWTE PLC control framework. Manage code releases using version control (Git), create and maintain reusable code libraries, and drive continuous improvement across all automation platforms.
Station’s PLC DRI: Serve as the PLC Direct Responsible Individual (DRI) for our most critical and complex test stations. You will take ownership of the system integration, orchestrating robots, vision systems, precision sensors, and actuators.
SIs Enablement & Bring-up: Act as the technical cornerstone for external System Integrators (SIs). You will onboard new SIs to Apple's frameworks, interpret technical specifications, provide training, and drive the successful commissioning, testing, and validation of new machines at manufacturing sites.
New System Initiatives: Lead the control-level integration for Apple's "Future Factory" initiatives. Partner with IT and Ops to connect machine PLCs to upper-level shop-floor systems, utilizing databases for data logging and exploring IIoT/AI technologies.
Apple-200665566.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Automation, or a related field.
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in PLC programming and industrial automation.
Core PLC & Architecture: Proficient in IEC 61131-3 languages with a strong emphasis on Structured Text (ST).
Proven, hands-on experience applying Object-Oriented.
Programming (OOP) principles within a PLC environment.
Platform Experience: Strong experience programming sophisticated automation systems. Note: Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 or CODESYS is highly preferred, but strong candidates with other platforms who are eager to transition to PC-based controls will be actively considered.
Motion & Integration: Deep experience with motion control (servo systems, stepper motors, motion controllers), including tuning and commissioning drives.
Electrical & Safety: Solid understanding of electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control panel design. Knowledge of machine functional safety standards (e.g., ISO 13849, IEC 62061).
Industrial Networking: Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting industrial protocols (EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus, etc.).
Communication & Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills. Outstanding XF communication skills to collaborate effectively with mechanical, electrical, and software teams.
Flexibility: Adaptable and willing to travel for field work, commissioning, and troubleshooting during critical project build phases.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Advanced Frameworks: Practical experience implementing ISA-88 batch control standards and PackML machine state models.
Safety Integration: Experience designing, implementing, and validating functional safety systems, particularly configuring safe I/O and programming safe logic within the TwinCAT Safety environment.
Software Engineering Tools: Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git) for PLC code management.
HMI/SCADA: Experience designing and programming Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) and SCADA systems.
High-Level Languages: Experience with high-level languages in an industrial context (e.g., Python, C#) and basic knowledge of databases.
Continuous Learning: A demonstrated willingness to learn new programming environments and keep pace with emerging automation technologies (Industry 4.0, IIoT).

Apple-200665566.full_text:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. Apple's Hardware Test Engineering (HWTE) group is looking for a passionate, highly collaborative PLC Automation Engineer. In this role, you will be at the heart of our automated test and calibration systems, architecting the control logic that ensures the flawless mass production of Apple's most innovative products. You will not only design complex machine logic but also own core automation frameworks, establish safety standards, and drive the integration of our equipment into Apple’s next-generation smart factory ecosystems.

As a PLC Automation Engineer in HWTE, you will own the software architecture, control logic, and integration of complex automated test fixtures. You will not be working in a silo: this role operates in a highly dynamic, cross-functional (XF) environment where you will partner daily with mechanical engineers, software engineers (macOS/iOS), test instrumentation specialists, and operations teams.
We need a technical leader who bridges the gap between traditional automation and modern software engineering.You will translate complex test requirements into robust, modular PLC code using Object- Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, while governing the automation standards used by our global vendors. If you have a deep passion for machine state modeling, excel at diagnosing electromechanical systems in the field, and want to lead the charge on "Future Factory" initiatives, we want to hear from you.

Core Architecture & Governance: Own the HWTE PLC control framework. Manage code releases using version control (Git), create and maintain reusable code libraries, and drive continuous improvement across all automation platforms.
Station’s PLC DRI: Serve as the PLC Direct Responsible Individual (DRI) for our most critical and complex test stations. You will take ownership of the system integration, orchestrating robots, vision systems, precision sensors, and actuators.
SIs Enablement & Bring-up: Act as the technical cornerstone for external System Integrators (SIs). You will onboard new SIs to Apple's frameworks, interpret technical specifications, provide training, and drive the successful commissioning, testing, and validation of new machines at manufacturing sites.
New System Initiatives: Lead the control-level integration for Apple's "Future Factory" initiatives. Partner with IT and Ops to connect machine PLCs to upper-level shop-floor systems, utilizing databases for data logging and exploring IIoT/AI technologies.

Apple-200663489.title: Packaging Product Design Engineer
Apple-200663489.description:
When was the last time you enjoyed a box as much as the product inside? At Apple, every customer interaction is an opportunity for surprise and delight! This philosophy extends beyond the product to its packaging, where every detail is thoughtfully considered.  

The Packaging PD team is a diverse group of people responsible for the design and execution of structural packaging for all Apple products - from shippers to finished goods boxes. Our packaging delivers an outstanding customer experience, while protecting products throughout the shipping environment, and advancing Apple’s sustainability goals. We collaborate with a wide range of teams including Industrial Design, Marketing, Environmental, Operations and many others during the design process.

We are seeking someone who approaches problem solving with passion, creativity, and curiosity. Apple’s approach to packaging is unique, so we value people who are eager to learn new skills and further improve their knowledge of packaging design, manufacturing processes, and sustainable materials. We welcome fresh influences from outside the standard packaging industry to promote innovation in creative ways.

Design and execute packaging architecture from initial prototypes to mass production with sustainable packaging materials
Utilize 2D and 3D CAD to design and document all parts and assemblies -Ensure design meets performance requirements throughout its lifecycle by performing materials analysis, stress, and failure analyses
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including industrial design, hardware, environmental, operations, and technology groups to refine and execute on the design on the packaging
Build models and prototypes to articulate design concepts, evaluate functionality, and validate packaging performance
Partner with internal manufacturing teams and external vendors to optimize designs for function, cosmetics, and manufacturability
Apple-200663489.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
3 years of related industry experience
BS degree with an emphasis in Mechanical Engineering or Packaging Science
Experience working with 3D and 2D CAD
Strong engineering fundamentals
Ability to travel up to 20% to support engineering build activities including finding root cause for failures and solutions for issues that impede build progress

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Innovative thinking and high personal motivation
Flexibility and comfort working in a quickly changing environment
Effective verbal and written presentation skills
Prototyping experience
Data-driven design approach to complex problems
Experience with design cycle from concept to manufacturing in mass-production
Knowledge of material science and FEA
Knowledge of fiber-based materials

Apple-200628600.title: Power Product Design Engineer
Apple-200628600.description:
Passion works here.  Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Our community is made up of every kind of individual: artists and designers, engineers and scientists, thinkers and doers. Together we create things and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined — and now can’t imagine living without. So if you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a career with Apple might be your dream job. Just be ready to dream big.

Apple is looking for a Product Design Engineer to be part of Apple’s Product Design Group in Shenzhen in China.  We are looking for someone who is passionate about engineering and thrives on innovation.  The role will require the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously with demanding schedule requirements across a large cross functional team. A proven ability to deliver solid design solutions while balancing multiple priorities is key. Experience closely working with suppliers is important as well. The engineer in this role will be very comfortable with applying scientific method and have be able to apply or create the process through which they can solve complex problems.
Apple-200628600.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS in mechanical engineering related fields
Good English communication skills in both written and verbal
Engineering fundamentals: statics, strength of materials, material science
Computer aided design (CAD) skills: 3D CAD experience required (NX preferred)
Design intelligence: mechanical intuition, creative problem solving, spatial reasoning, diligence in finding the best solution for each design challenge, attention to detail
Interested in traveling up to 50% throughout a year

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Basic design skills: tolerances analysis, design for assembly (DFA), design for manufacturing (DFM), simple fixture design, understanding of Statistical Process Controls (SPC), understanding of metrology (basic knowledge of measurement systems)
Experience in design cycle from concept through manufacturing
Experience in designing mechanical components for high volume manufacturing - injection molded parts, sheet metal components, die-cast and machined parts
Experience in team work with Contract Manufacturing Partners
Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity, and thus we treat all applicants fairly and equally. Apple is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Apple-200663266.title: Power Systems Integration Engineer (HWEE) - Wireless Power Division
Apple-200663266.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  

The success we are striving will be the result of very skilled people working in an environment which cultivates creativity, partnership, and thinking of old problems in new ways.   

The mission of the Wireless Power Technology team - Create the world’s best Wireless Charging user-experience by inventing state-of-the-art technologies. We develop effortless and safe Wireless Charging designs that are central to Apple’s products - the iPad, iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods and MagSafe! New challenges arise every day that require the sharp problem-solving skills of individuals. Are you in for the challenges?

We are looking for a Hardware Engineer that can help close the gap between design and manufacturing by working closely with the various factory teams to lead the integration of the inductive technology into products. This is done in partnership with multiple discipline teams including, but not limited to factory, architecture, FW, system EE, silicon, noise and vibration, safety, thermal, reliability, operations, regulatory teams and more.

Key responsibilities for this role include providing critical on-site support for factory builds during early prototype and engineering build phases of various Apple programs leading up to Mass Production. This requires you to be able to dig deep into any problems that may arise during a factory build and think critically to help resolve them in a fast paced, data driven environment. You will be expected to meet a high standard for analysis and manufacturing discipline, and work with cross functional teams all around the world to enable us to pass all specifications and requirements necessary to ship a product.  

- System bring-up, characterisation, testing and validation 
- System-level problem solving - failure analysis, root cause & corrective action proposal 
- Debug test sequences on automated test equipment 
- Design of Experiments (DOE) creation, execution and data analysis 
- Write technical documentation (Eg. requirements, specifications and test plans) 
- Review and analyse build data to help inform critical program decisions. Provide detailed build report summaries and present findings with clear summaries and takeaways. 
- Frequent business travel required, up to or exceeding 50%. (Primarily within China. To a lesser extent New Zealand and USA)
Apple-200663266.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.
Strong foundational knowledge in both analog and digital design, coupled with exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving skills to tackle complex challenges.
Hands-on experience with prototype bring-up, hardware debugging, and functional verification.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin.
Collaborative team player who can also work independently, take ownership of projects, and drive results with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Expertise in power electronics and magnetics; a background in wireless power technologies is highly advantageous.
Strong understanding of low-power embedded systems and standard communication protocols (including USB, SPMI, SPI, I2C, and UART).
Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional firmware teams. Direct coding proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or C is a strong plus.
Experience in high-volume product design and manufacturing, including statistical production tolerance analysis and Gauge R&R methodology.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating a passion for innovation, engineering rigor, and a meticulous approach to quality.

Apple-200685578.title: Principal Software Engineer - Apple Data Platform
Apple-200685578.description:
Help us build the Apple Data Platform in China! We are establishing a new engineering organization from the ground up to build and operate Apple's next-generation data platform for customers in China. As the founding principal engineer on the team, you'll own the architecture of the platform that powers data, analytics, and AI workloads while meeting regional regulatory and data residency requirements.

Working in close partnership with the global Apple Data Platform organization, you'll bring world-class platform capabilities to China, solve large-scale distributed systems challenges, and set the technical foundation that will support Apple's long-term growth in the region.

As a Principal Software Engineer within the Apple Data Platform organization, you will serve as the senior-most individual contributor responsible for establishing and evolving the Apple Data Platform in China. This is a unique greenfield opportunity to build a new regional engineering capability while working on one of Apple's most strategic infrastructure initiatives.

You will own the design, implementation, deployment, and operation of core platform services that enable data, analytics, and AI workloads across China. Working closely with engineering teams across China and the United States, you will deliver global platform capabilities while ensuring the platform meets regional operational, security, and regulatory requirements.

As a principal technical leader, you will set architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, define technical best practices, and build a highly reliable, scalable, and secure platform that serves customers across the region.

Own the design, build, deployment, and operation of core components of the Apple Data Platform in China.
Set the technical design and architecture of platform services, and shape the global Apple Data Platform architecture they align to.
Partner closely with engineering teams across the United States and China to deliver new platform capabilities and maintain feature parity with the global platform. 
Set the bar for reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence across platform services and infrastructure.
Define and develop infrastructure automation, deployment tooling, and operational workflows that simplify platform management and improve engineering productivity.
Resolve the hardest distributed systems problems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, storage, and data platform services.
Drive improvements in observability, monitoring, incident response, automation, and operational efficiency. 
Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and SRE teams across Apple to deliver a seamless platform experience. 
Own multi-year technical strategy and architectural direction, and establish the engineering standards and best practices for the growing China engineering organization.
Grow senior and staff engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and day-to-day technical leadership.
Apple-200685578.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
15+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or platform technologies in production environments.
Track record of owning architecture and delivering complex infrastructure or platform initiatives across multiple engineering organizations.
Expert-level software engineering experience in Java, Go, Scala, Python, C++, or similar programming languages.
Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, and modern infrastructure platforms.
Proven history of building and operating highly available, scalable, secure, and observable production systems at scale.
Experience designing automation for deployment, infrastructure management, and operational excellence. 
Exceptional debugging and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.
Experience setting technical direction across software engineering, infrastructure, SRE, security, and product organizations.
Excellent communication skills and a record of influencing technical direction across globally distributed engineering organizations.
BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience architecting large-scale data, analytics, AI, or machine learning platforms.
Experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Spark, Ray, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Airflow, or other modern data platform technologies. 
Experience deploying and operating platforms across public cloud providers such as Alibaba Cloud, AWS, or GCP, as well as private cloud or on-premises environments. 
Experience founding greenfield infrastructure or platform initiatives.
Experience operating services in regulated environments with security, compliance, and data residency requirements. 
Experience building developer platforms, platform automation, and self-service infrastructure. 
Passion for building world-class infrastructure and helping establish a new engineering organization from the ground up.

Apple-200676555.title: Product Design Engineer - SiP NPI
Apple-200676555.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. You will become part of a hands-on development team that sets the standard in cultivating excellence, creativity and innovation. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll define something.

As one of us (SiP process NPI team), you will interface between internal product/device design, quality, supply chain, and the external suppliers to develop and deploy new System-in-Package (SiP) technologies. We are looking for individuals who are innovative with a proven track record to bring packaging solution from concept to high-volume manufacturing.

As a SiP NPI engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing next generation SiP process for various of end products. You will be deeply involved from early design phase , prove-of-concept phase (POC), multiple NPI build phases, and hand over to MP team until risk ramp. During these phases, you will be the key stakeholder to lead OSAT’s process team for process development & qualification per projects assigned.You will also be the major contact window to behavior of our team and collaborate with Internal / external X-function teams.

Collaborate with x-function team, to define next-gen SiP architecture based on assessment of functionality / form factor / process capability

Define general process flow and assess process risk per different options, co-work with internal RD team or OSAT team for early validation to de-risk and update risk level based on validation result 

Work with internal project management team, to define NPI timeline, detailed bring up plan, formal build plan, post build plan and etc

Take lead for process development in POC build & NPI build, drive OSAT process team to bring up each process steps (material down-selection, equipment qualification, tooling design, recipes fine tune) , integrate as one robust process flow and deliver SiP with timely manner (based on NPI build plan) & high quality (yield, reliability)

Work with EE team & REL team for process related FA, take lead of process trouble shooting, commonality study, corrective actions and drive till closure.

Drive OSAT team, material vendor, equipment vendor for potential process yield improvement, cost reduction, design rule improvement.

~ 20% domestic / international travel
Apple-200676555.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
M.S degree in mechanical engineering, physics, materials science or equivalent, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in IC packaging (for Bachelor, minimum 5 years experience is required)

General knowledge / experience in overall SiP process, panel level packaging process or wafer level packaging process, including SMT (surface mounting technology), underfill, die attach, wire bond, molding, dicing saw, Laser and sputter thin film materials.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Extensive experiences about transfer molding with fine pitch IC or sputter thin film processes for EMI shielding, in the context of high-volume semiconductor/packaging/electronics manufacturing

Proven ability to lead internal or external team for assembly process development and qualification of semiconductor packages

Good understanding and skill for material characterizations, semiconductor packaging,  component failure analysis, design for experiments, mechanical simulation and data analysis (JMP)

Ability to work under pressure with a wide range of people with varying degrees of experience

Familiar with quality tools, including SPC, Cpk, DOE, data distribution, data correlation, commonality study and etc

Excellent communication skills with both Mandarin & English

Apple-200608835.title: Product Design Engineer - Vision Pro
Apple-200608835.description:
At Apple, we believe our products begin with our people. By hiring a team with varied strengths, we drive creative thought. By giving that team everything they need, we drive innovation. By hiring incredible engineers, we drive precision. And through our collaborative process, we build memorable experiences for our customers.
These elements come together to make Apple an amazing environment for motivated people to do the greatest work of their lives. You will become part of a hands-on development team that sets the standard in cultivating excellence, creativity and innovation. Will you help us design the next generation of revolutionary Apple products?
The Vision Products Group is looking for highly-motivated mechanical product design engineer to join our team in Shenzhen, China or Shanghai, China. This is a highly collaborative and creative role that will be critical to the design of the next generation of Vision products. As an emerging product field, this role offers unique and interesting engineering challenges fit for the most inquisitive and clever candidates.

We’re seeking someone with strong mechanical design skills, an ability to lead projects, and excellent communication skills both with vendors in Asia and designers inside Apple. You will be responsible for driving failure analysis, building prototypes, studying analytical models, and organizing DOEs as we study novel designs. As designs mature, you will work on-site at contract manufacturers within China to implement and assemble the team’s designs. Up to 40% total travel required.
Apple-200608835.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent 
2+ years of experience in product design or engineering field (preferably consumer electronic products – computers, cell phones, cameras, etc.)
Working knowledge of 3D CAD programs. Unigraphics NX is a plus.
Understanding of Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), statistical tolerance analysis techniques, functional dimensioning, and geometric tolerancing.
Worked within international teams and OEM/ODM vendors.
Proficiency in both Mandarin Chinese and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
5+ years of experience in product design or engineering field (preferably consumer electronic products – computers, cell phones, cameras, etc.)
Deep understanding of engineering fundamentals and ability to apply concepts to new problems not listed in engineering textbooks.
Detail orientated, enthusiastic thinker, and capable of handling multiple assignments under high pressure.
Strong analytical problem solving skills and ability to use statistical tools and techniques.
Experience with plastic and metal part design and fabrication techniques.
Experience developing mechanisms in mass-produced products.
Post-processing knowledge for plastic and metal part, including assembly and fixture design.

Apple-200676251.title: Product Design Engineering Program Manager - Apple Vision Pro
Apple-200676251.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.

PD EPM is a hands-on programmatic role where you and your team will be responsible for delivering the mechanical enclosure & assembly through the entire program life-cycle—from architecture definition and early design to mass production. It includes frequent multi-disciplinary collaboration with teams like Product Design, Industrial Design, Materials, Manufacturing, Display, Camera, Antenna, Battery, and more. You will be responsible for driving the program through the entire development process, creating and maintaining streamlined schedules, driving PD and cross-functional progress, managing manufacturing/assembly upstream and at the vendor factories, and presenting multiple levels of status updates to org leaders and executives.

Drive the strategic execution of Vision Pro product design, ensuring alignment with overall project goals and objectives.
Champion the project's design goals, ensuring they are integrated into all aspects of the program and holding teams accountable for achieving them.
Lead the creation and adherence of project schedules, ensuring key decision milestones are met across all phases and holding teams accountable.
Manage budgets, track spending, and ensure financial prudence; proactively identifying appropriate scope drivers and their cost implications.
Facilitate clear and consistent communication and alignment between internal teams such as Product Design, Industrial Design (CMF), Manufacturing. and external partners, ensuring everyone is working towards the same goals.
Provide strong leadership and support during build phases, ensuring timely delivery of components, proactive problem-solving, and definition of validation plans.
Oversee the release process for parts and enclosures, ensuring timely and accurate releases and holding teams accountable for meeting release deadlines.
Apple-200676251.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Previous experience in program management and mechanical/electrical engineering delivering products comprised of multiple materials
Experience leading product development in highly dynamic and ambiguous work environments, supporting the mechanical assembly and integration of multiple technologies
Excellent communication, teamwork, cross-functional engagement, and strong presentation skills
Ability to anticipate functional direction and roadblocks, prioritize parallel closure paths, effectively distill and communicate relevant data to the appropriate functional and leadership teams
Self-motivated and detail-oriented with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities
Experience engaging with manufacturers on DFM, FAI/CPK, QC, and production timelines
BSME degree or equivalent; MS degree preferred

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
5+ years of experience working with Product Design, Industrial Design, Operations, and System Architecture
Wide knowledge of product development processes including detailed understanding of manufacturing processes and tooling timelines
Shipped multiple full life-cycle programs with demonstrated experience in early architecture, development build NPI execution, and operational mass-production
Experience as primary point of contact with vendors and CM partners to establish a daily build plan, provide clear direction and guidance to meet the program and build objectives
